ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous aimerions une table près de la fenêtre, si ce n'est pas trop demander.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We'd like a table by the window, if it's not too much to ask.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Gostaríamos de uma mesa perto da janela, se não for pedir demais.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pourriez-vous me dire si ce plat contient des fruits à coque, car je suis allergique ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you tell me whether this dish contains nuts, because I'm allergic?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia me dizer se este prato contém castanhas, porque eu sou alérgico?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je voudrais que la viande soit bien cuite, s'il vous plaît, et sans sauce.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd like the meat well done, please, and without sauce.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu queria a carne bem passada, por favor, e sem molho.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il faudrait qu'on réserve à l'avance, ce restaurant est toujours complet le samedi soir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We should book in advance; this restaurant is always full on Saturday nights.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A gente deveria reservar com antecedência, esse restaurante está sempre lotado no sábado à noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Bien que le service ait été un peu lent, nous avons très bien mangé.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Although the service was a bit slow, we ate very well.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Embora o atendimento tenha sido um pouco lento, comemos muito bem.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez nous apporter l'addition dès que vous aurez un moment ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring us the bill as soon as you have a moment?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia nos trazer a conta assim que tiver um momento?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le serveur nous a conseillé un vin de Loire qui allait parfaitement avec le poisson.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The waiter recommended a Loire wine that went perfectly with the fish.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O garçom nos recomendou um vinho do Loire que combinava perfeitamente com o peixe.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je ne pense pas que le menu du jour soit encore disponible à cette heure-ci.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I don't think the set menu of the day is still available at this time.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Não acho que o prato do dia ainda esteja disponível a essa hora.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Si j'avais su que les portions étaient si copieuses, je n'aurais pas pris d'entrée.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: If I'd known the portions were so generous, I wouldn't have ordered a starter.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Se eu soubesse que as porções eram tão fartas, não teria pedido entrada.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Excusez-moi, mais je crois qu'il y a une erreur dans l'addition.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, but I think there's a mistake in the bill.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, mas acho que tem um erro na conta.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ça vous dérangerait de remplacer les frites par une salade verte ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you mind replacing the fries with a green salad?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você se importaria de trocar as batatas fritas por uma salada verde?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Camille a commandé un café crème et un croissant, comme tous les matins.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Camille ordered a coffee with cream and a croissant, like every morning.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Camille pediu um café com creme e um croissant, como todas as manhãs.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On partage un dessert à deux ou chacun prend le sien ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Shall we share a dessert between the two of us, or does each of us get our own?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A gente divide uma sobremesa ou cada um pede a sua?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le chef propose une formule à vingt-cinq euros qui comprend entrée, plat et dessert.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The chef offers a twenty-five-euro set menu that includes a starter, main course and dessert.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O chef oferece um menu de vinte e cinco euros que inclui entrada, prato principal e sobremesa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je préférerais qu'on s'installe en terrasse, puisqu'il fait encore beau.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd rather we sat outside on the terrace, since the weather is still nice.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu preferiria que a gente sentasse na área externa, já que o tempo ainda está bom.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Avant de commander, pourriez-vous nous expliquer ce qu'est la spécialité de la maison ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Before we order, could you explain what the house speciality is?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Antes de pedirmos, você poderia nos explicar qual é a especialidade da casa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il est rare qu'on trouve un aussi bon rapport qualité-prix dans ce quartier.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: It's rare to find such good value for money in this neighbourhood.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: É raro encontrar um custo-benefício tão bom neste bairro.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous sommes huit, est-ce que vous auriez de la place sans réservation ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: There are eight of us; would you have room without a reservation?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Somos oito, vocês teriam lugar sem reserva?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Mon steak est arrivé presque froid, alors j'ai demandé qu'on le réchauffe.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: My steak arrived almost cold, so I asked them to heat it up.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Meu bife chegou quase frio, então pedi que o esquentassem.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pour moi, ce sera le magret de canard avec un verre de bordeaux.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: For me, it'll be the duck breast with a glass of Bordeaux.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Para mim, vai ser o peito de pato com uma taça de vinho Bordeaux.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je vous recommande vivement la tarte Tatin, elle est faite maison.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I highly recommend the tarte Tatin; it's homemade.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Recomendo muito a torta Tatin, ela é caseira.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que le service est compris ou faut-il laisser un pourboire ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is service included, or should we leave a tip?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O serviço está incluído ou é preciso deixar gorjeta?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On attend depuis vingt minutes et personne n'est encore venu prendre notre commande.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We've been waiting for twenty minutes and nobody has come to take our order yet.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Estamos esperando há vinte minutos e ninguém veio anotar nosso pedido ainda.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Bien qu'il soit végétarien, Thomas a trouvé plusieurs plats qui lui plaisaient.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Even though he's vegetarian, Thomas found several dishes he liked.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Mesmo sendo vegetariano, o Thomas encontrou vários pratos de que gostou.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pourriez-vous mettre les restes dans une boîte pour que je les emporte ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you put the leftovers in a box so I can take them with me?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia colocar as sobras numa embalagem para eu levar?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: J'ai l'impression que la carte a complètement changé depuis la dernière fois.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I get the feeling the menu has completely changed since last time.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Tenho a impressão de que o cardápio mudou completamente desde a última vez.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je prendrai un expresso bien serré et une carafe d'eau, s'il vous plaît.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'll have a very strong espresso and a jug of water, please.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vou querer um expresso bem forte e uma jarra de água, por favor.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il vaudrait mieux que tu goûtes avant d'ajouter du sel, c'est déjà très assaisonné.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: You'd better taste it before adding salt; it's already well seasoned.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: É melhor você provar antes de pôr sal, já está bem temperado.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous voudrions payer séparément, si cela ne pose pas de problème.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We'd like to pay separately, if that's not a problem.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Gostaríamos de pagar separado, se não for problema.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le patron nous a offert le digestif parce que nous sommes des habitués.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The owner gave us an after-dinner drink on the house because we're regulars.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O dono nos ofereceu o digestivo porque somos clientes habituais.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous avez une carte des vins au verre ou seulement à la bouteille ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you have wines by the glass, or only by the bottle?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês têm carta de vinhos em taça ou só em garrafa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je doute que nous ayons le temps de prendre un dessert avant le film.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I doubt we'll have time for dessert before the film.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Duvido que a gente tenha tempo de comer uma sobremesa antes do filme.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce bistrot sert le meilleur croque-monsieur que j'aie jamais mangé.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This bistro serves the best croque-monsieur I've ever eaten.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Este bistrô serve o melhor croque-monsieur que eu já comi.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que vous acceptez les tickets-restaurant pour le menu du midi ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you accept meal vouchers for the lunch menu?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês aceitam vale-refeição para o menu do almoço?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Dès que nous aurons fini l'entrée, vous pourrez apporter les plats principaux.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: As soon as we've finished the starter, you can bring the main courses.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Assim que terminarmos a entrada, você pode trazer os pratos principais.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Léa a renvoyé son plat en cuisine parce que les pâtes étaient trop cuites.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Léa sent her dish back to the kitchen because the pasta was overcooked.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Léa devolveu o prato para a cozinha porque o macarrão estava cozido demais.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ça fait longtemps que je voulais essayer ce petit restaurant japonais du coin.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I've wanted to try this little Japanese restaurant around the corner for a long time.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Faz tempo que eu queria experimentar esse restaurantezinho japonês da esquina.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Auriez-vous une chaise haute pour notre fille, s'il vous plaît ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you have a high chair for our daughter, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês teriam uma cadeirinha para a nossa filha, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Quoi que tu choisisses, sache que tout est délicieux ici.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Whatever you choose, know that everything here is delicious.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Seja lá o que você escolher, saiba que tudo aqui é delicioso.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous avons réservé une table pour quatre au nom de Martin, à vingt heures.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We've booked a table for four under the name Martin, at eight p.m.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Reservamos uma mesa para quatro em nome de Martin, às vinte horas.

travel and directions.text: Pourriez-vous m'indiquer le chemin le plus court pour aller à la gare de Lyon ?
travel and directions.en: Could you show me the shortest way to the Gare de Lyon?
travel and directions.pt: Você poderia me indicar o caminho mais curto para a Gare de Lyon?

travel and directions.text: Il faut que nous soyons à l'aéroport au moins deux heures avant le décollage.
travel and directions.en: We need to be at the airport at least two hours before take-off.
travel and directions.pt: Precisamos estar no aeroporto pelo menos duas horas antes da decolagem.

travel and directions.text: Si vous prenez la deuxième rue à gauche, vous tomberez directement sur la place.
travel and directions.en: If you take the second street on the left, you'll come right out onto the square.
travel and directions.pt: Se você pegar a segunda rua à esquerda, vai dar direto na praça.

travel and directions.text: Notre train a été annulé à cause d'une grève, donc nous avons dû louer une voiture.
travel and directions.en: Our train was cancelled because of a strike, so we had to rent a car.
travel and directions.pt: Nosso trem foi cancelado por causa de uma greve, então tivemos que alugar um carro.

travel and directions.text: Je ne suis pas sûr que ce bus aille jusqu'au centre-ville.
travel and directions.en: I'm not sure this bus goes all the way to the city centre.
travel and directions.pt: Não tenho certeza de que esse ônibus vá até o centro da cidade.

travel and directions.text: Une fois arrivés à Marseille, nous prendrons le ferry pour la Corse.
travel and directions.en: Once we get to Marseille, we'll take the ferry to Corsica.
travel and directions.pt: Quando chegarmos a Marselha, vamos pegar a balsa para a Córsega.

travel and directions.text: Excusez-moi, est-ce que le musée est loin d'ici à pied ?
travel and directions.en: Excuse me, is the museum far from here on foot?
travel and directions.pt: Com licença, o museu fica longe daqui a pé?

travel and directions.text: Bien que le vol ait eu trois heures de retard, la compagnie ne nous a rien proposé.
travel and directions.en: Although the flight was three hours late, the airline offered us nothing.
travel and directions.pt: Embora o voo tenha atrasado três horas, a companhia não nos ofereceu nada.

travel and directions.text: Vous continuez tout droit jusqu'au rond-point, puis vous prenez la sortie vers Nantes.
travel and directions.en: Keep going straight to the roundabout, then take the exit towards Nantes.
travel and directions.pt: Siga em frente até a rotatória e depois pegue a saída para Nantes.

travel and directions.text: Il vaut mieux acheter les billets en ligne, c'est souvent moins cher qu'au guichet.
travel and directions.en: It's better to buy tickets online; it's often cheaper than at the counter.
travel and directions.pt: É melhor comprar as passagens pela internet, costuma ser mais barato do que no guichê.

travel and directions.text: Nous avons perdu nos valises lors de l'escale à Francfort.
travel and directions.en: We lost our suitcases during the stopover in Frankfurt.
travel and directions.pt: Perdemos nossas malas durante a escala em Frankfurt.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce qu'il y a une station de métro dans les environs ?
travel and directions.en: Is there a metro station nearby?
travel and directions.pt: Tem alguma estação de metrô aqui por perto?

travel and directions.text: Julien s'est trompé de direction et nous avons mis une heure de plus pour arriver.
travel and directions.en: Julien went the wrong way and it took us an extra hour to get there.
travel and directions.pt: O Julien errou o caminho e levamos uma hora a mais para chegar.

travel and directions.text: À votre place, j'éviterais l'autoroute le vendredi soir, c'est toujours bouché.
travel and directions.en: If I were you, I'd avoid the motorway on Friday evenings; it's always jammed.
travel and directions.pt: No seu lugar, eu evitaria a rodovia na sexta à noite, está sempre engarrafada.

travel and directions.text: N'oublie pas de valider ton ticket avant de monter dans le tram.
travel and directions.en: Don't forget to validate your ticket before getting on the tram.
travel and directions.pt: Não esqueça de validar seu bilhete antes de entrar no bonde.

travel and directions.text: L'hôtel se trouve à deux pas de la cathédrale, vous ne pouvez pas le manquer.
travel and directions.en: The hotel is a stone's throw from the cathedral; you can't miss it.
travel and directions.pt: O hotel fica a dois passos da catedral, não tem como errar.

travel and directions.text: Je cherche un endroit où je pourrais louer un vélo pour la journée.
travel and directions.en: I'm looking for a place where I could rent a bike for the day.
travel and directions.pt: Estou procurando um lugar onde eu possa alugar uma bicicleta por um dia.

travel and directions.text: Pourvu qu'il n'y ait pas de bouchons, sinon on va rater le début du concert.
travel and directions.en: Let's hope there's no traffic, otherwise we'll miss the start of the concert.
travel and directions.pt: Tomara que não tenha trânsito, senão vamos perder o começo do show.

travel and directions.text: Combien de temps faut-il compter pour aller de Paris à Bordeaux en TGV ?
travel and directions.en: How long does it take to get from Paris to Bordeaux by high-speed train?
travel and directions.pt: Quanto tempo leva para ir de Paris a Bordeaux de trem-bala?

travel and directions.text: Le GPS nous a fait passer par des petites routes de campagne magnifiques.
travel and directions.en: The GPS took us along some beautiful little country roads.
travel and directions.pt: O GPS nos fez passar por umas estradinhas rurais lindas.

travel and directions.text: Nous avions prévu de visiter Lyon, mais finalement nous sommes restés à Annecy.
travel and directions.en: We had planned to visit Lyon, but in the end we stayed in Annecy.
travel and directions.pt: Tínhamos planejado visitar Lyon, mas no fim ficamos em Annecy.

travel and directions.text: Pour aller au château, descendez à l'arrêt Mairie et marchez environ dix minutes.
travel and directions.en: To get to the castle, get off at the Town Hall stop and walk for about ten minutes.
travel and directions.pt: Para ir ao castelo, desça no ponto da Prefeitura e caminhe uns dez minutos.

travel and directions.text: Je me suis perdu dans les ruelles du vieux quartier, mais un passant m'a aidé.
travel and directions.en: I got lost in the alleyways of the old town, but a passer-by helped me.
travel and directions.pt: Eu me perdi nas vielas do bairro antigo, mas um pedestre me ajudou.

travel and directions.text: Quel que soit le moyen de transport, le trajet prendra au moins quatre heures.
travel and directions.en: Whatever the means of transport, the journey will take at least four hours.
travel and directions.pt: Qualquer que seja o meio de transporte, a viagem vai levar pelo menos quatro horas.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce que ce billet est encore valable si je prends le train suivant ?
travel and directions.en: Is this ticket still valid if I take the next train?
travel and directions.pt: Esta passagem ainda vale se eu pegar o próximo trem?

travel and directions.text: Avant de partir, vérifie que ton passeport n'est pas périmé.
travel and directions.en: Before you leave, check that your passport hasn't expired.
travel and directions.pt: Antes de viajar, confira se o seu passaporte não está vencido.

travel and directions.text: Sophie voyage toujours avec un simple sac à dos, même pour trois semaines.
travel and directions.en: Sophie always travels with just a backpack, even for three weeks.
travel and directions.pt: A Sophie sempre viaja só com uma mochila, mesmo por três semanas.

travel and directions.text: On nous a conseillé de traverser le pont et de longer le fleuve jusqu'au port.
travel and directions.en: We were advised to cross the bridge and follow the river down to the harbour.
travel and directions.pt: Nos aconselharam a atravessar a ponte e seguir ao longo do rio até o porto.

travel and directions.text: Il est possible que la ligne 4 soit fermée ce week-end pour travaux.
travel and directions.en: Line 4 may be closed this weekend for engineering works.
travel and directions.pt: É possível que a linha 4 esteja fechada neste fim de semana para obras.

travel and directions.text: Nous aurions aimé rester plus longtemps à Strasbourg, mais le temps nous manquait.
travel and directions.en: We would have liked to stay longer in Strasbourg, but we were short of time.
travel and directions.pt: Teríamos gostado de ficar mais tempo em Estrasburgo, mas faltou tempo.

travel and directions.text: Vous savez à quelle heure part le dernier bus pour l'aéroport ?
travel and directions.en: Do you know what time the last bus to the airport leaves?
travel and directions.pt: Você sabe a que horas sai o último ônibus para o aeroporto?

travel and directions.text: La location de voiture était bien moins chère que ce que nous avions imaginé.
travel and directions.en: The car rental was much cheaper than we had imagined.
travel and directions.pt: O aluguel do carro foi bem mais barato do que tínhamos imaginado.

travel and directions.text: Si je me souviens bien, la boulangerie est juste après le feu rouge.
travel and directions.en: If I remember correctly, the bakery is just after the traffic light.
travel and directions.pt: Se não me engano, a padaria fica logo depois do semáforo.

travel and directions.text: Mon vol pour Montréal fait une escale de six heures à Reykjavik.
travel and directions.en: My flight to Montreal has a six-hour layover in Reykjavik.
travel and directions.pt: Meu voo para Montreal tem uma escala de seis horas em Reykjavik.

travel and directions.text: Je préfère voyager hors saison pour éviter la foule et les prix élevés.
travel and directions.en: I prefer travelling off-season to avoid the crowds and high prices.
travel and directions.pt: Prefiro viajar na baixa temporada para evitar multidões e preços altos.

travel and directions.text: Le contrôleur m'a mis une amende parce que je n'avais pas validé mon billet.
travel and directions.en: The inspector fined me because I hadn't validated my ticket.
travel and directions.pt: O fiscal me multou porque eu não tinha validado minha passagem.

travel and directions.text: Une fois que vous aurez passé l'église, c'est la troisième maison sur la droite.
travel and directions.en: Once you've gone past the church, it's the third house on the right.
travel and directions.pt: Depois de passar a igreja, é a terceira casa à direita.

travel and directions.text: Est-ce qu'il faut réserver sa place dans ce train ou on peut monter sans réservation ?
travel and directions.en: Do you have to book a seat on this train, or can you get on without a reservation?
travel and directions.pt: É preciso reservar lugar neste trem ou dá para embarcar sem reserva?

travel and directions.text: Nous comptons faire le tour de la Bretagne en camping-car l'été prochain.
travel and directions.en: We're planning to tour Brittany in a camper van next summer.
travel and directions.pt: Pretendemos dar a volta pela Bretanha de motorhome no próximo verão.

travel and directions.text: Il se peut que vous deviez changer de train à Dijon, renseignez-vous au guichet.
travel and directions.en: You may have to change trains in Dijon; ask at the ticket office.
travel and directions.pt: Pode ser que você tenha que trocar de trem em Dijon, informe-se no guichê.

shopping.text: Est-ce que vous auriez ce pull dans une taille au-dessus ?
shopping.en: Would you have this jumper in the next size up?
shopping.pt: Vocês teriam este suéter num tamanho maior?

shopping.text: Je cherche un cadeau pour ma mère, mais je ne sais pas du tout ce qui lui plairait.
shopping.en: I'm looking for a present for my mother, but I have no idea what she'd like.
shopping.pt: Estou procurando um presente para a minha mãe, mas não faço ideia do que ela gostaria.

shopping.text: Bien que cette veste soit en solde, elle reste un peu trop chère pour moi.
shopping.en: Even though this jacket is on sale, it's still a bit too expensive for me.
shopping.pt: Embora esta jaqueta esteja em promoção, ainda está um pouco cara para mim.

shopping.text: Si l'article ne vous convient pas, vous pouvez le rapporter sous trente jours.
shopping.en: If the item doesn't suit you, you can bring it back within thirty days.
shopping.pt: Se o produto não servir, você pode devolvê-lo em até trinta dias.

shopping.text: Pourriez-vous me faire un paquet cadeau, s'il vous plaît ?
shopping.en: Could you gift-wrap it for me, please?
shopping.pt: Você poderia fazer um embrulho para presente, por favor?

shopping.text: Il faudrait que je passe au supermarché avant qu'il ne ferme.
shopping.en: I should stop by the supermarket before it closes.
shopping.pt: Eu precisaria passar no supermercado antes que ele feche.

shopping.text: Ces chaussures sont jolies, mais elles me font mal aux pieds.
shopping.en: These shoes are pretty, but they hurt my feet.
shopping.pt: Esses sapatos são bonitos, mas machucam meus pés.

shopping.text: J'ai acheté cet aspirateur en ligne et il est tombé en panne au bout d'une semaine.
shopping.en: I bought this vacuum cleaner online and it broke down after a week.
shopping.pt: Comprei este aspirador pela internet e ele quebrou depois de uma semana.

shopping.text: Vous acceptez la carte bancaire ou seulement les espèces ?
shopping.en: Do you take cards, or cash only?
shopping.pt: Vocês aceitam cartão ou só dinheiro?

shopping.text: Je me demande si ça vaut vraiment la peine d'attendre les soldes de janvier.
shopping.en: I wonder whether it's really worth waiting for the January sales.
shopping.pt: Eu me pergunto se vale mesmo a pena esperar as liquidações de janeiro.

shopping.text: Le vendeur m'a assuré que ce téléphone était garanti deux ans.
shopping.en: The salesman assured me this phone came with a two-year warranty.
shopping.pt: O vendedor me garantiu que este celular tinha dois anos de garantia.

shopping.text: Nous faisons nos courses au marché le dimanche matin, les produits y sont plus frais.
shopping.en: We do our shopping at the market on Sunday mornings; the produce is fresher there.
shopping.pt: Fazemos compras na feira no domingo de manhã, lá os produtos são mais frescos.

shopping.text: Je voudrais être remboursé, car le produit ne correspond pas à la description.
shopping.en: I'd like a refund, because the product doesn't match the description.
shopping.pt: Eu gostaria de ser reembolsado, porque o produto não corresponde à descrição.

shopping.text: Excusez-moi, où se trouvent les cabines d'essayage, s'il vous plaît ?
shopping.en: Excuse me, where are the fitting rooms, please?
shopping.pt: Com licença, onde ficam os provadores, por favor?

shopping.text: Il est hors de question que je dépense deux cents euros pour un sac.
shopping.en: There's no way I'm spending two hundred euros on a bag.
shopping.pt: Está fora de questão eu gastar duzentos euros numa bolsa.

shopping.text: Marie compare toujours les prix sur plusieurs sites avant d'acheter quoi que ce soit.
shopping.en: Marie always compares prices on several websites before buying anything.
shopping.pt: A Marie sempre compara os preços em vários sites antes de comprar qualquer coisa.

shopping.text: Est-ce que je pourrais avoir un ticket de caisse au cas où je voudrais l'échanger ?
shopping.en: Could I have a receipt in case I want to exchange it?
shopping.pt: Eu poderia ficar com o cupom fiscal caso eu queira trocar?

shopping.text: Ce magasin propose une réduction de dix pour cent aux étudiants.
shopping.en: This shop offers students a ten percent discount.
shopping.pt: Esta loja oferece um desconto de dez por cento para estudantes.

shopping.text: Je ne trouve pas le rayon des produits bio, vous pourriez m'aider ?
shopping.en: I can't find the organic food aisle; could you help me?
shopping.pt: Não estou achando a seção de produtos orgânicos, você poderia me ajudar?

shopping.text: Si j'avais su qu'il y avait une promotion, j'en aurais acheté deux.
shopping.en: If I'd known there was a special offer, I'd have bought two.
shopping.pt: Se eu soubesse que tinha promoção, teria comprado dois.

shopping.text: On m'a livré la mauvaise couleur, alors j'ai dû appeler le service client.
shopping.en: They delivered the wrong colour, so I had to call customer service.
shopping.pt: Entregaram a cor errada, então tive que ligar para o atendimento ao cliente.

shopping.text: À votre avis, cette robe me va mieux en bleu ou en noir ?
shopping.en: In your opinion, does this dress suit me better in blue or in black?
shopping.pt: Na sua opinião, este vestido fica melhor em mim no azul ou no preto?

shopping.text: Pensez à apporter vos propres sacs, car les sacs plastique sont désormais payants.
shopping.en: Remember to bring your own bags, as plastic bags now cost extra.
shopping.pt: Lembre-se de trazer suas próprias sacolas, porque agora as sacolas plásticas são cobradas.

shopping.text: Il est possible que cet article soit en rupture de stock jusqu'à la fin du mois.
shopping.en: This item may be out of stock until the end of the month.
shopping.pt: É possível que este produto fique em falta até o fim do mês.

shopping.text: J'ai craqué pour une lampe ancienne dans une brocante près de chez moi.
shopping.en: I couldn't resist an antique lamp at a flea market near my place.
shopping.pt: Não resisti a uma luminária antiga num brechó perto de casa.

shopping.text: Je préfère acheter local, même si c'est parfois un peu plus cher.
shopping.en: I prefer to buy local, even if it's sometimes a bit more expensive.
shopping.pt: Prefiro comprar de produtores locais, mesmo que às vezes seja um pouco mais caro.

shopping.text: Ce n'est pas la peine de m'emballer ça, je vais le porter tout de suite.
shopping.en: No need to wrap that for me; I'm going to wear it right away.
shopping.pt: Não precisa embrulhar, vou usar agora mesmo.

shopping.text: Pourriez-vous mettre ce manteau de côté jusqu'à demain, le temps que j'en parle à mon mari ?
shopping.en: Could you put this coat aside until tomorrow, so I have time to talk to my husband about it?
shopping.pt: Você poderia separar este casaco até amanhã, enquanto eu converso com meu marido?

shopping.text: Le centre commercial est tellement bondé le samedi que j'évite d'y aller.
shopping.en: The shopping centre is so packed on Saturdays that I avoid going there.
shopping.pt: O shopping fica tão lotado no sábado que eu evito ir lá.

shopping.text: Combien coûte la livraison si je commande plus de cinquante euros ?
shopping.en: How much is delivery if I order more than fifty euros' worth?
shopping.pt: Quanto custa a entrega se eu fizer um pedido acima de cinquenta euros?

shopping.text: Antoine a fini par acheter le même ordinateur que son frère.
shopping.en: Antoine ended up buying the same computer as his brother.
shopping.pt: O Antoine acabou comprando o mesmo computador que o irmão.

shopping.text: Je doute que ce prix inclue l'installation de la machine à laver.
shopping.en: I doubt this price includes installing the washing machine.
shopping.pt: Duvido que esse preço inclua a instalação da máquina de lavar.

shopping.text: Les fruits sont à trois euros le kilo, mais ils sont vraiment délicieux.
shopping.en: The fruit is three euros a kilo, but it's really delicious.
shopping.pt: As frutas custam três euros o quilo, mas são realmente deliciosas.

shopping.text: Je cherche un jean un peu plus ajusté, sans être trop serré.
shopping.en: I'm looking for jeans that are a bit more fitted, without being too tight.
shopping.pt: Estou procurando uma calça jeans um pouco mais ajustada, sem ser apertada demais.

shopping.text: Avant d'acheter un vélo d'occasion, demande au vendeur si tu peux l'essayer.
shopping.en: Before buying a second-hand bike, ask the seller if you can try it out.
shopping.pt: Antes de comprar uma bicicleta usada, pergunte ao vendedor se você pode testá-la.

shopping.text: Il paraît que cette boutique ferme définitivement à la fin de l'année.
shopping.en: Apparently this shop is closing for good at the end of the year.
shopping.pt: Parece que esta loja vai fechar de vez no fim do ano.

shopping.text: Est-ce que vous faites des retouches ou faut-il aller chez un couturier ?
shopping.en: Do you do alterations, or do I need to go to a tailor?
shopping.pt: Vocês fazem ajustes ou é preciso ir a uma costureira?

shopping.text: J'ai payé en trois fois sans frais, ce qui m'a bien arrangé.
shopping.en: I paid in three interest-free instalments, which really suited me.
shopping.pt: Paguei em três vezes sem juros, o que me ajudou bastante.

shopping.text: Quoi qu'en dise la publicité, ce produit n'est pas de très bonne qualité.
shopping.en: Whatever the advertising says, this product isn't very good quality.
shopping.pt: Diga o que disser a propaganda, este produto não é de muito boa qualidade.

shopping.text: Vous me faites un petit prix si je prends les deux ?
shopping.en: Will you give me a discount if I take both?
shopping.pt: Você faz um precinho se eu levar os dois?

work and meetings.text: Il faut absolument que nous terminions ce rapport avant la réunion de jeudi.
work and meetings.en: We absolutely have to finish this report before Thursday's meeting.
work and meetings.pt: Precisamos terminar este relatório de qualquer jeito antes da reunião de quinta.

work and meetings.text: Je vous propose qu'on fasse un point rapide sur l'avancement du projet.
work and meetings.en: I suggest we do a quick update on the project's progress.
work and meetings.pt: Proponho que a gente faça um balanço rápido do andamento do projeto.

work and meetings.text: Bien que la réunion ait duré deux heures, nous n'avons rien décidé.
work and meetings.en: Although the meeting lasted two hours, we didn't decide anything.
work and meetings.pt: Embora a reunião tenha durado duas horas, não decidimos nada.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous m'envoyer l'ordre du jour avant demain matin ?
work and meetings.en: Could you send me the agenda before tomorrow morning?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia me enviar a pauta antes de amanhã de manhã?

work and meetings.text: Le directeur souhaite que chaque équipe présente ses résultats trimestriels.
work and meetings.en: The director wants each team to present its quarterly results.
work and meetings.pt: O diretor quer que cada equipe apresente seus resultados trimestrais.

work and meetings.text: Si nous ne respectons pas les délais, le client risque d'annuler le contrat.
work and meetings.en: If we don't meet the deadlines, the client might cancel the contract.
work and meetings.pt: Se não cumprirmos os prazos, o cliente pode cancelar o contrato.

work and meetings.text: Je suis désolé, mais je ne pourrai pas assister à la réunion de cet après-midi.
work and meetings.en: I'm sorry, but I won't be able to attend this afternoon's meeting.
work and meetings.pt: Sinto muito, mas não vou poder participar da reunião desta tarde.

work and meetings.text: Nathalie a été promue cheffe de projet après seulement deux ans dans l'entreprise.
work and meetings.en: Nathalie was promoted to project manager after only two years at the company.
work and meetings.pt: A Nathalie foi promovida a gerente de projeto depois de apenas dois anos na empresa.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que quelqu'un pourrait prendre des notes pendant la réunion ?
work and meetings.en: Could someone take notes during the meeting?
work and meetings.pt: Alguém poderia fazer anotações durante a reunião?

work and meetings.text: Je ne pense pas que ce soit le bon moment pour demander une augmentation.
work and meetings.en: I don't think it's the right time to ask for a raise.
work and meetings.pt: Não acho que seja o momento certo para pedir um aumento.

work and meetings.text: On a décidé de passer au télétravail deux jours par semaine.
work and meetings.en: We've decided to switch to working from home two days a week.
work and meetings.pt: Decidimos passar para o home office dois dias por semana.

work and meetings.text: Le nouveau logiciel devrait nous faire gagner beaucoup de temps, à condition qu'on soit bien formés.
work and meetings.en: The new software should save us a lot of time, provided we're properly trained.
work and meetings.pt: O novo software deve nos fazer ganhar muito tempo, desde que sejamos bem treinados.

work and meetings.text: Avant de prendre une décision, j'aimerais avoir l'avis de toute l'équipe.
work and meetings.en: Before making a decision, I'd like to hear the whole team's opinion.
work and meetings.pt: Antes de tomar uma decisão, eu gostaria de ouvir a opinião de toda a equipe.

work and meetings.text: La visioconférence a été interrompue à cause d'un problème de connexion.
work and meetings.en: The video call was cut off because of a connection problem.
work and meetings.pt: A videoconferência foi interrompida por causa de um problema de conexão.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous reporter notre rendez-vous à la semaine prochaine ?
work and meetings.en: Could you postpone our meeting until next week?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia adiar nossa reunião para a semana que vem?

work and meetings.text: Il est essentiel que tout le monde soit au courant des nouvelles procédures.
work and meetings.en: It's essential that everyone is aware of the new procedures.
work and meetings.pt: É essencial que todos estejam cientes dos novos procedimentos.

work and meetings.text: Je travaille sur ce dossier depuis trois semaines et je n'en vois pas la fin.
work and meetings.en: I've been working on this file for three weeks and I can't see the end of it.
work and meetings.pt: Estou trabalhando neste processo há três semanas e não vejo o fim.

work and meetings.text: Mon collègue Karim est en congé jusqu'au quinze, je m'occupe de ses clients.
work and meetings.en: My colleague Karim is on leave until the fifteenth, so I'm handling his clients.
work and meetings.pt: Meu colega Karim está de folga até o dia quinze, eu estou cuidando dos clientes dele.

work and meetings.text: On aurait dû anticiper ce problème dès le début du projet.
work and meetings.en: We should have anticipated this problem from the start of the project.
work and meetings.pt: A gente deveria ter previsto esse problema desde o início do projeto.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous reformuler votre question, car je ne suis pas sûr d'avoir bien compris ?
work and meetings.en: Could you rephrase your question, as I'm not sure I understood correctly?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia reformular sua pergunta, porque não tenho certeza de ter entendido bem?

work and meetings.text: Le budget a été réduit de quinze pour cent, il va falloir faire des choix.
work and meetings.en: The budget has been cut by fifteen percent, so we'll have to make some choices.
work and meetings.pt: O orçamento foi reduzido em quinze por cento, vamos ter que fazer escolhas.

work and meetings.text: Je vous remercie d'avoir pris le temps de venir malgré votre emploi du temps chargé.
work and meetings.en: Thank you for taking the time to come despite your busy schedule.
work and meetings.pt: Agradeço por ter tirado um tempo para vir apesar da sua agenda cheia.

work and meetings.text: À mon avis, nous devrions confier cette tâche à quelqu'un de plus expérimenté.
work and meetings.en: In my view, we should give this task to someone more experienced.
work and meetings.pt: Na minha opinião, deveríamos confiar essa tarefa a alguém mais experiente.

work and meetings.text: J'ai passé un entretien d'embauche ce matin et je pense que ça s'est bien passé.
work and meetings.en: I had a job interview this morning and I think it went well.
work and meetings.pt: Fiz uma entrevista de emprego hoje de manhã e acho que foi bem.

work and meetings.text: Il se peut que la réunion commence avec quelques minutes de retard.
work and meetings.en: The meeting may start a few minutes late.
work and meetings.pt: Pode ser que a reunião comece com alguns minutos de atraso.

work and meetings.text: Nous avons signé un partenariat avec une entreprise allemande le mois dernier.
work and meetings.en: We signed a partnership with a German company last month.
work and meetings.pt: Assinamos uma parceria com uma empresa alemã no mês passado.

work and meetings.text: Je crains que nous n'ayons pas assez de personnel pour ce projet.
work and meetings.en: I'm afraid we don't have enough staff for this project.
work and meetings.pt: Receio que não tenhamos pessoal suficiente para este projeto.

work and meetings.text: Pour la prochaine fois, merci de m'envoyer les documents au moins deux jours à l'avance.
work and meetings.en: Next time, please send me the documents at least two days in advance.
work and meetings.pt: Da próxima vez, por favor me envie os documentos com pelo menos dois dias de antecedência.

work and meetings.text: La pause déjeuner est le seul moment où l'on peut vraiment discuter entre collègues.
work and meetings.en: The lunch break is the only time we can really chat as colleagues.
work and meetings.pt: O intervalo do almoço é o único momento em que dá para conversar de verdade entre colegas.

work and meetings.text: Quoi qu'il arrive, il faut que le prototype soit prêt pour le salon de mars.
work and meetings.en: Whatever happens, the prototype must be ready for the March trade fair.
work and meetings.pt: Aconteça o que acontecer, o protótipo precisa estar pronto para a feira de março.

work and meetings.text: Elle a démissionné parce qu'elle ne supportait plus les heures supplémentaires.
work and meetings.en: She resigned because she couldn't stand the overtime any more.
work and meetings.pt: Ela pediu demissão porque não aguentava mais as horas extras.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que tout le monde est d'accord pour qu'on passe au point suivant ?
work and meetings.en: Does everyone agree that we move on to the next item?
work and meetings.pt: Todo mundo concorda que a gente passe para o próximo item?

work and meetings.text: Je vais faire suivre votre message à la personne responsable du service.
work and meetings.en: I'll forward your message to the person in charge of the department.
work and meetings.pt: Vou encaminhar sua mensagem para a pessoa responsável pelo setor.

work and meetings.text: Notre équipe a dépassé ses objectifs de vente pour le troisième mois consécutif.
work and meetings.en: Our team has exceeded its sales targets for the third month in a row.
work and meetings.pt: Nossa equipe superou as metas de vendas pelo terceiro mês consecutivo.

work and meetings.text: Si vous avez des questions, n'hésitez pas à me contacter directement.
work and meetings.en: If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact me directly.
work and meetings.pt: Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em me contatar diretamente.

work and meetings.text: Le séminaire annuel aura lieu dans un hôtel près de Lille au mois de juin.
work and meetings.en: The annual seminar will take place in a hotel near Lille in June.
work and meetings.pt: O seminário anual vai acontecer num hotel perto de Lille no mês de junho.

work and meetings.text: J'aimerais qu'on revienne sur ce que Paul a dit au début de la réunion.
work and meetings.en: I'd like us to go back to what Paul said at the start of the meeting.
work and meetings.pt: Eu gostaria que a gente voltasse ao que o Paul disse no início da reunião.

work and meetings.text: Depuis que nous avons changé de manager, l'ambiance au bureau s'est nettement améliorée.
work and meetings.en: Since we got a new manager, the atmosphere in the office has clearly improved.
work and meetings.pt: Desde que trocamos de gerente, o clima no escritório melhorou bastante.

work and meetings.text: Il est temps de faire le bilan de l'année et de fixer de nouveaux objectifs.
work and meetings.en: It's time to review the year and set new goals.
work and meetings.pt: Está na hora de fazer o balanço do ano e definir novas metas.

work and meetings.text: Vous pensez qu'on peut boucler ce dossier d'ici vendredi ?
work and meetings.en: Do you think we can wrap up this file by Friday?
work and meetings.pt: Você acha que a gente consegue fechar esse processo até sexta?

family and friends.text: Mes parents fêtent leurs quarante ans de mariage le mois prochain.
family and friends.en: My parents are celebrating their fortieth wedding anniversary next month.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais comemoram quarenta anos de casados no mês que vem.

family and friends.text: Je regrette que nous ne nous voyions pas plus souvent depuis que tu as déménagé.
family and friends.en: I'm sorry we don't see each other more often since you moved.
family and friends.pt: Lamento que a gente não se veja com mais frequência desde que você se mudou.

family and friends.text: Ma grand-mère nous racontait toujours des histoires de son enfance en Bretagne.
family and friends.en: My grandmother always used to tell us stories about her childhood in Brittany.
family and friends.pt: Minha avó sempre nos contava histórias da infância dela na Bretanha.

family and friends.text: Bien qu'ils soient jumeaux, Lucas et Hugo n'ont pas du tout le même caractère.
family and friends.en: Even though they're twins, Lucas and Hugo have completely different personalities.
family and friends.pt: Embora sejam gêmeos, o Lucas e o Hugo não têm nada a ver um com o outro de personalidade.

family and friends.text: On se connaît depuis le collège et on ne s'est jamais perdus de vue.
family and friends.en: We've known each other since middle school and we've never lost touch.
family and friends.pt: A gente se conhece desde o ensino fundamental e nunca perdemos o contato.

family and friends.text: Si tu as besoin d'un coup de main pour ton déménagement, compte sur moi.
family and friends.en: If you need a hand with your move, count on me.
family and friends.pt: Se você precisar de uma ajuda na mudança, pode contar comigo.

family and friends.text: Ma sœur vient d'avoir un bébé, je suis donc tante pour la première fois.
family and friends.en: My sister has just had a baby, so I'm an aunt for the first time.
family and friends.pt: Minha irmã acabou de ter um bebê, então sou tia pela primeira vez.

family and friends.text: Il faudrait qu'on organise un dîner avec tous les cousins pour Noël.
family and friends.en: We should organise a dinner with all the cousins for Christmas.
family and friends.pt: A gente deveria organizar um jantar com todos os primos no Natal.

family and friends.text: Mon frère et moi, on se disputait tout le temps quand on était petits.
family and friends.en: My brother and I used to argue all the time when we were little.
family and friends.pt: Eu e meu irmão brigávamos o tempo todo quando éramos pequenos.

family and friends.text: J'ai rencontré ma meilleure amie lors d'un échange universitaire à Barcelone.
family and friends.en: I met my best friend during a university exchange in Barcelona.
family and friends.pt: Conheci minha melhor amiga durante um intercâmbio universitário em Barcelona.

family and friends.text: Ça me ferait vraiment plaisir que tu viennes à mon anniversaire samedi.
family and friends.en: I'd be really pleased if you came to my birthday party on Saturday.
family and friends.pt: Eu ficaria muito feliz se você viesse ao meu aniversário no sábado.

family and friends.text: Mes beaux-parents habitent à la campagne, à une heure de Toulouse.
family and friends.en: My in-laws live in the countryside, an hour from Toulouse.
family and friends.pt: Meus sogros moram no interior, a uma hora de Toulouse.

family and friends.text: Nous passons toujours les vacances d'été chez mon oncle, au bord de la mer.
family and friends.en: We always spend the summer holidays at my uncle's, by the sea.
family and friends.pt: Sempre passamos as férias de verão na casa do meu tio, na praia.

family and friends.text: Je ne m'entends pas très bien avec mon beau-frère, mais je fais des efforts.
family and friends.en: I don't get on very well with my brother-in-law, but I'm making an effort.
family and friends.pt: Não me dou muito bem com meu cunhado, mas estou me esforçando.

family and friends.text: Clara m'a confié un secret et je lui ai promis de ne le répéter à personne.
family and friends.en: Clara told me a secret and I promised her I wouldn't tell anyone.
family and friends.pt: A Clara me contou um segredo e eu prometi não contar para ninguém.

family and friends.text: Depuis la naissance des enfants, on a beaucoup moins de temps pour sortir entre amis.
family and friends.en: Since the children were born, we have much less time to go out with friends.
family and friends.pt: Desde que os filhos nasceram, temos bem menos tempo para sair com os amigos.

family and friends.text: Je suis content que tu aies enfin rencontré quelqu'un qui te rende heureux.
family and friends.en: I'm glad you've finally met someone who makes you happy.
family and friends.pt: Fico feliz que você finalmente tenha conhecido alguém que te faça feliz.

family and friends.text: Ça fait des années que je n'ai pas eu de nouvelles de mon ami d'enfance.
family and friends.en: I haven't heard from my childhood friend in years.
family and friends.pt: Faz anos que não tenho notícias do meu amigo de infância.

family and friends.text: Mes enfants se chamaillent sans arrêt, ça me rend fou.
family and friends.en: My kids bicker non-stop; it drives me crazy.
family and friends.pt: Meus filhos brigam sem parar, isso me deixa louco.

family and friends.text: On a fait une surprise à Julie pour ses trente ans, elle ne se doutait de rien.
family and friends.en: We threw Julie a surprise for her thirtieth birthday; she didn't suspect a thing.
family and friends.pt: Fizemos uma surpresa para a Julie nos trinta anos dela, ela não desconfiou de nada.

family and friends.text: Bien que nous vivions loin les uns des autres, nous nous appelons chaque dimanche.
family and friends.en: Although we live far apart, we call each other every Sunday.
family and friends.pt: Embora a gente more longe uns dos outros, nos falamos por telefone todo domingo.

family and friends.text: Mon neveu aimerait faire des études de médecine, comme sa mère.
family and friends.en: My nephew would like to study medicine, like his mother.
family and friends.pt: Meu sobrinho gostaria de estudar medicina, como a mãe.

family and friends.text: Tu devrais appeler ta mère, elle s'inquiète quand elle n'a pas de nouvelles.
family and friends.en: You should call your mother; she worries when she doesn't hear from you.
family and friends.pt: Você deveria ligar para sua mãe, ela fica preocupada quando não tem notícias.

family and friends.text: Nous avons adopté un chat pour que les enfants apprennent à s'occuper d'un animal.
family and friends.en: We adopted a cat so the children would learn to look after an animal.
family and friends.pt: Adotamos um gato para que as crianças aprendam a cuidar de um animal.

family and friends.text: C'est chez ma tante qu'on se réunit tous pour le réveillon.
family and friends.en: It's at my aunt's that we all get together for Christmas Eve dinner.
family and friends.pt: É na casa da minha tia que todos nos reunimos para a ceia de Natal.

family and friends.text: Il est normal que les adolescents aient besoin de plus d'indépendance.
family and friends.en: It's normal for teenagers to need more independence.
family and friends.pt: É normal que os adolescentes precisem de mais independência.

family and friends.text: Je me suis réconcilié avec Marc après des mois sans nous parler.
family and friends.en: I made up with Marc after months of not speaking to each other.
family and friends.pt: Fiz as pazes com o Marc depois de meses sem nos falarmos.

family and friends.text: Ma fille cadette ressemble beaucoup à son grand-père.
family and friends.en: My younger daughter looks a lot like her grandfather.
family and friends.pt: Minha filha caçula é muito parecida com o avô.

family and friends.text: Est-ce que tes parents savent que tu vas partir vivre au Canada ?
family and friends.en: Do your parents know you're going to move to Canada?
family and friends.pt: Seus pais sabem que você vai morar no Canadá?

family and friends.text: Pour le mariage de mon cousin, toute la famille est venue de Belgique.
family and friends.en: For my cousin's wedding, the whole family came over from Belgium.
family and friends.pt: Para o casamento do meu primo, a família toda veio da Bélgica.

family and friends.text: Une vraie amie, c'est quelqu'un qui te dit la vérité même quand ça fait mal.
family and friends.en: A true friend is someone who tells you the truth even when it hurts.
family and friends.pt: Uma amiga de verdade é alguém que te diz a verdade mesmo quando dói.

family and friends.text: On a passé un week-end génial entre copains dans un gîte en Ardèche.
family and friends.en: We spent a great weekend with friends in a holiday cottage in the Ardèche.
family and friends.pt: Passamos um fim de semana incrível com os amigos numa casa de campo na Ardèche.

family and friends.text: Mon mari s'occupe des enfants le mercredi, puisqu'il ne travaille pas ce jour-là.
family and friends.en: My husband looks after the children on Wednesdays, since he doesn't work that day.
family and friends.pt: Meu marido cuida das crianças na quarta-feira, já que ele não trabalha nesse dia.

family and friends.text: J'aimerais que mes enfants gardent un lien fort avec leurs grands-parents.
family and friends.en: I'd like my children to keep a strong bond with their grandparents.
family and friends.pt: Eu gostaria que meus filhos mantivessem um vínculo forte com os avós.

family and friends.text: Nos voisins sont devenus de véritables amis au fil des années.
family and friends.en: Our neighbours have become real friends over the years.
family and friends.pt: Nossos vizinhos se tornaram verdadeiros amigos ao longo dos anos.

family and friends.text: Je ne savais pas que vous étiez frère et sœur, vous ne vous ressemblez pas du tout !
family and friends.en: I didn't know you were brother and sister; you don't look alike at all!
family and friends.pt: Eu não sabia que vocês eram irmãos, vocês não se parecem nada!

family and friends.text: Il faut que je pense à acheter un cadeau pour la fête des Pères.
family and friends.en: I need to remember to buy a present for Father's Day.
family and friends.pt: Preciso lembrar de comprar um presente para o Dia dos Pais.

family and friends.text: Ma meilleure amie est toujours là pour moi, quoi qu'il arrive.
family and friends.en: My best friend is always there for me, no matter what.
family and friends.pt: Minha melhor amiga está sempre do meu lado, aconteça o que acontecer.

family and friends.text: Avec mes copines, on part chaque année quelques jours ensemble sans les maris.
family and friends.en: Every year my girlfriends and I go away for a few days together without our husbands.
family and friends.pt: Todo ano eu e minhas amigas viajamos juntas por alguns dias sem os maridos.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai mal à la gorge depuis trois jours et j'ai un peu de fièvre.
health and the doctor.en: I've had a sore throat for three days and I have a slight fever.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com dor de garganta há três dias e com um pouco de febre.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin m'a conseillé de rester au lit jusqu'à ce que la fièvre baisse.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor advised me to stay in bed until the fever goes down.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me aconselhou a ficar de cama até a febre baixar.

health and the doctor.text: Il faut que vous preniez ce médicament deux fois par jour pendant les repas.
health and the doctor.en: You need to take this medicine twice a day with meals.
health and the doctor.pt: Você precisa tomar este remédio duas vezes por dia durante as refeições.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez me prescrire quelque chose contre la toux ?
health and the doctor.en: Could you prescribe me something for my cough?
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor poderia me receitar alguma coisa para a tosse?

health and the doctor.text: Je me suis tordu la cheville en courant et elle a beaucoup enflé.
health and the doctor.en: I twisted my ankle while running and it has swollen up a lot.
health and the doctor.pt: Torci o tornozelo correndo e ele inchou bastante.

health and the doctor.text: Bien que je dorme huit heures par nuit, je me sens fatigué en permanence.
health and the doctor.en: Even though I sleep eight hours a night, I feel tired all the time.
health and the doctor.pt: Embora eu durma oito horas por noite, me sinto cansado o tempo todo.

health and the doctor.text: Si les symptômes persistent, revenez me voir dans une semaine.
health and the doctor.en: If the symptoms persist, come back and see me in a week.
health and the doctor.pt: Se os sintomas persistirem, volte a me procurar daqui a uma semana.

health and the doctor.text: Le dentiste m'a dit que j'avais deux caries à soigner.
health and the doctor.en: The dentist told me I had two cavities that need treating.
health and the doctor.pt: O dentista me disse que eu tinha duas cáries para tratar.

health and the doctor.text: Je suis allergique à la pénicilline, il faudrait que ce soit noté dans mon dossier.
health and the doctor.en: I'm allergic to penicillin; it should be noted in my file.
health and the doctor.pt: Sou alérgico à penicilina, isso deveria estar anotado no meu prontuário.

health and the doctor.text: Depuis que je fais du sport régulièrement, j'ai beaucoup moins mal au dos.
health and the doctor.en: Since I started exercising regularly, my back hurts much less.
health and the doctor.pt: Desde que comecei a fazer exercício regularmente, sinto muito menos dor nas costas.

health and the doctor.text: La pharmacienne m'a recommandé un sirop à base de plantes.
health and the doctor.en: The pharmacist recommended a herbal syrup.
health and the doctor.pt: A farmacêutica me recomendou um xarope à base de plantas.

health and the doctor.text: Il est important que vous buviez beaucoup d'eau et que vous vous reposiez.
health and the doctor.en: It's important that you drink plenty of water and rest.
health and the doctor.pt: É importante que você beba bastante água e descanse.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai pris rendez-vous chez un dermatologue, mais il n'y avait pas de place avant deux mois.
health and the doctor.en: I made an appointment with a dermatologist, but there was nothing available for two months.
health and the doctor.pt: Marquei consulta com um dermatologista, mas não tinha vaga antes de dois meses.

health and the doctor.text: Pierre s'est cassé le bras au ski et il a un plâtre pour six semaines.
health and the doctor.en: Pierre broke his arm skiing and has a cast for six weeks.
health and the doctor.pt: O Pierre quebrou o braço esquiando e vai ficar engessado por seis semanas.

health and the doctor.text: Je ne pense pas que ce soit grave, mais je préfère consulter un médecin.
health and the doctor.en: I don't think it's serious, but I'd rather see a doctor.
health and the doctor.pt: Não acho que seja grave, mas prefiro consultar um médico.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que ce médicament est remboursé par la Sécurité sociale ?
health and the doctor.en: Is this medicine reimbursed by the national health insurance?
health and the doctor.pt: Este remédio é reembolsado pela previdência social?

health and the doctor.text: On m'a fait une prise de sang pour vérifier mon taux de cholestérol.
health and the doctor.en: They took a blood sample to check my cholesterol level.
health and the doctor.pt: Fizeram um exame de sangue para verificar meu nível de colesterol.

health and the doctor.text: Vous devriez arrêter de fumer, ne serait-ce que pour vos poumons.
health and the doctor.en: You should stop smoking, if only for your lungs.
health and the doctor.pt: Você deveria parar de fumar, nem que seja pelos seus pulmões.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai des migraines de plus en plus fréquentes, surtout en fin de journée.
health and the doctor.en: I'm getting migraines more and more often, especially at the end of the day.
health and the doctor.pt: Tenho enxaquecas cada vez mais frequentes, sobretudo no fim do dia.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin m'a donné un arrêt maladie de cinq jours.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor signed me off sick for five days.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me deu um atestado de cinco dias.

health and the doctor.text: Avez-vous des antécédents de maladies cardiaques dans votre famille ?
health and the doctor.en: Is there any history of heart disease in your family?
health and the doctor.pt: Há histórico de doenças cardíacas na sua família?

health and the doctor.text: Il vaudrait mieux que tu passes une radio pour être sûr qu'il n'y a rien de cassé.
health and the doctor.en: You'd better get an X-ray to make sure nothing is broken.
health and the doctor.pt: Seria melhor você fazer um raio-X para ter certeza de que não quebrou nada.

health and the doctor.text: Ma mère doit se faire opérer du genou au mois de mars.
health and the doctor.en: My mother is due to have knee surgery in March.
health and the doctor.pt: Minha mãe vai operar o joelho no mês de março.

health and the doctor.text: Respirez profondément et toussez deux ou trois fois pendant que je vous ausculte.
health and the doctor.en: Breathe deeply and cough two or three times while I listen to your chest.
health and the doctor.pt: Respire fundo e tussa duas ou três vezes enquanto eu ausculto você.

health and the doctor.text: Les urgences étaient tellement pleines que nous avons attendu quatre heures.
health and the doctor.en: A&E was so full that we waited four hours.
health and the doctor.pt: O pronto-socorro estava tão cheio que esperamos quatro horas.

health and the doctor.text: Je souffre d'insomnie depuis que j'ai changé de travail.
health and the doctor.en: I've been suffering from insomnia since I changed jobs.
health and the doctor.pt: Sofro de insônia desde que mudei de emprego.

health and the doctor.text: Pourriez-vous me dire où se trouve la pharmacie de garde la plus proche ?
health and the doctor.en: Could you tell me where the nearest on-duty pharmacy is?
health and the doctor.pt: Você poderia me dizer onde fica a farmácia de plantão mais próxima?

health and the doctor.text: À moins que la douleur ne s'aggrave, il n'est pas nécessaire de revenir.
health and the doctor.en: Unless the pain gets worse, there's no need to come back.
health and the doctor.pt: A menos que a dor piore, não é necessário voltar.

health and the doctor.text: Elle fait de la kiné deux fois par semaine depuis son accident.
health and the doctor.en: She's been doing physiotherapy twice a week since her accident.
health and the doctor.pt: Ela faz fisioterapia duas vezes por semana desde o acidente.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai oublié mon ordonnance, est-ce que vous pourriez m'en refaire une ?
health and the doctor.en: I forgot my prescription; could you write me a new one?
health and the doctor.pt: Esqueci minha receita, o senhor poderia fazer outra para mim?

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin craint que ce ne soit une infection, donc il m'a prescrit des antibiotiques.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor is worried it might be an infection, so he prescribed me antibiotics.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico teme que seja uma infecção, então me receitou antibióticos.

health and the doctor.text: Mon fils a attrapé la varicelle à la crèche, il est couvert de boutons.
health and the doctor.en: My son caught chickenpox at nursery; he's covered in spots.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu filho pegou catapora na creche, está coberto de bolinhas.

health and the doctor.text: Je dois porter des lunettes pour lire, ma vue a beaucoup baissé.
health and the doctor.en: I have to wear glasses to read; my eyesight has got much worse.
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso usar óculos para ler, minha visão piorou bastante.

health and the doctor.text: Il ne faut surtout pas arrêter le traitement avant la fin, même si vous allez mieux.
health and the doctor.en: You really mustn't stop the treatment before the end, even if you feel better.
health and the doctor.pt: Não interrompa o tratamento antes do fim de jeito nenhum, mesmo que você melhore.

health and the doctor.text: Dites-moi si vous avez mal quand j'appuie ici, sur le côté droit.
health and the doctor.en: Tell me if it hurts when I press here, on the right side.
health and the doctor.pt: Me diga se dói quando eu aperto aqui, do lado direito.

health and the doctor.text: J'essaie de marcher au moins trente minutes par jour pour rester en forme.
health and the doctor.en: I try to walk at least thirty minutes a day to stay in shape.
health and the doctor.pt: Tento caminhar pelo menos trinta minutos por dia para ficar em forma.

health and the doctor.text: Le stress peut avoir des effets importants sur la santé, il ne faut pas le négliger.
health and the doctor.en: Stress can have a big impact on health; it shouldn't be overlooked.
health and the doctor.pt: O estresse pode ter efeitos importantes na saúde, não se deve ignorá-lo.

health and the doctor.text: Je voudrais faire un bilan de santé complet, ça fait des années que je n'en ai pas fait.
health and the doctor.en: I'd like a full check-up; I haven't had one in years.
health and the doctor.pt: Eu gostaria de fazer um check-up completo, faz anos que não faço um.

weather and seasons.text: D'après la météo, il devrait pleuvoir tout le week-end.
weather and seasons.en: According to the forecast, it should rain all weekend.
weather and seasons.pt: Segundo a previsão do tempo, deve chover o fim de semana inteiro.

weather and seasons.text: Bien qu'il fasse beau, il fait encore assez froid pour porter un manteau.
weather and seasons.en: Although it's sunny, it's still cold enough to wear a coat.
weather and seasons.pt: Embora o tempo esteja bom, ainda está frio o bastante para usar casaco.

weather and seasons.text: J'adore l'automne, quand les feuilles changent de couleur dans les parcs.
weather and seasons.en: I love autumn, when the leaves change colour in the parks.
weather and seasons.pt: Adoro o outono, quando as folhas mudam de cor nos parques.

weather and seasons.text: Il a tellement neigé cette nuit que les routes sont bloquées.
weather and seasons.en: It snowed so much last night that the roads are blocked.
weather and seasons.pt: Nevou tanto esta noite que as estradas estão bloqueadas.

weather and seasons.text: Si le temps le permet, nous irons pique-niquer au bord du lac dimanche.
weather and seasons.en: Weather permitting, we'll go for a picnic by the lake on Sunday.
weather and seasons.pt: Se o tempo permitir, vamos fazer um piquenique à beira do lago no domingo.

weather and seasons.text: Cet été, la canicule a duré presque trois semaines dans le sud de la France.
weather and seasons.en: This summer, the heatwave lasted almost three weeks in the south of France.
weather and seasons.pt: Neste verão, a onda de calor durou quase três semanas no sul da França.

weather and seasons.text: Prends un parapluie, on ne sait jamais avec ce temps.
weather and seasons.en: Take an umbrella; you never know with this weather.
weather and seasons.pt: Leve um guarda-chuva, nunca se sabe com esse tempo.

weather and seasons.text: Je crains que l'orage n'éclate avant que nous soyons rentrés.
weather and seasons.en: I'm afraid the storm will break before we get home.
weather and seasons.pt: Receio que a tempestade caia antes de chegarmos em casa.

weather and seasons.text: Les températures vont chuter d'au moins dix degrés dès demain.
weather and seasons.en: Temperatures are going to drop by at least ten degrees from tomorrow.
weather and seasons.pt: As temperaturas vão cair pelo menos dez graus a partir de amanhã.

weather and seasons.text: On n'a pas vu le soleil depuis une semaine, ça commence à me déprimer.
weather and seasons.en: We haven't seen the sun for a week; it's starting to get me down.
weather and seasons.pt: Não vemos o sol há uma semana, isso está começando a me deprimir.

weather and seasons.text: Au printemps, les cerisiers du jardin sont couverts de fleurs blanches.
weather and seasons.en: In spring, the cherry trees in the garden are covered in white blossom.
weather and seasons.pt: Na primavera, as cerejeiras do jardim ficam cobertas de flores brancas.

weather and seasons.text: Il paraît que l'hiver sera particulièrement rude cette année.
weather and seasons.en: Apparently the winter will be particularly harsh this year.
weather and seasons.pt: Dizem que o inverno vai ser particularmente rigoroso este ano.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait un temps idéal pour une balade en forêt.
weather and seasons.en: It's perfect weather for a walk in the woods.
weather and seasons.pt: Está um tempo ideal para um passeio na floresta.

weather and seasons.text: Le brouillard était si épais ce matin qu'on ne voyait pas à dix mètres.
weather and seasons.en: The fog was so thick this morning that you couldn't see ten metres ahead.
weather and seasons.pt: A neblina estava tão densa hoje de manhã que não dava para ver a dez metros.

weather and seasons.text: Je préfère la chaleur sèche du Midi à l'humidité de Paris en été.
weather and seasons.en: I prefer the dry heat of the South of France to the humidity of Paris in summer.
weather and seasons.pt: Prefiro o calor seco do sul da França à umidade de Paris no verão.

weather and seasons.text: Il est rare qu'il neige à Bordeaux, mais ça arrive de temps en temps.
weather and seasons.en: It rarely snows in Bordeaux, but it does happen from time to time.
weather and seasons.pt: É raro nevar em Bordeaux, mas acontece de vez em quando.

weather and seasons.text: Les agriculteurs attendent la pluie avec impatience après ce mois de sécheresse.
weather and seasons.en: Farmers are eagerly waiting for rain after this month of drought.
weather and seasons.pt: Os agricultores esperam a chuva com ansiedade depois deste mês de seca.

weather and seasons.text: Quel temps fait-il chez vous en ce moment, il pleut toujours autant ?
weather and seasons.en: What's the weather like where you are at the moment; is it still raining as much?
weather and seasons.pt: Como está o tempo aí no momento, continua chovendo tanto?

weather and seasons.text: Nous avons dû annuler la randonnée à cause du vent violent.
weather and seasons.en: We had to cancel the hike because of the strong wind.
weather and seasons.pt: Tivemos que cancelar a trilha por causa do vento forte.

weather and seasons.text: Il a fait un froid de canard toute la semaine, même à midi.
weather and seasons.en: It's been freezing cold all week, even at midday.
weather and seasons.pt: Fez um frio de rachar a semana toda, até ao meio-dia.

weather and seasons.text: Je trouve que les saisons sont de moins en moins marquées ces dernières années.
weather and seasons.en: I find the seasons have become less and less distinct in recent years.
weather and seasons.pt: Acho que as estações estão cada vez menos definidas nos últimos anos.

weather and seasons.text: En hiver, il fait nuit dès cinq heures, et ça me fatigue.
weather and seasons.en: In winter it gets dark by five o'clock, and that wears me out.
weather and seasons.pt: No inverno, escurece já às cinco horas, e isso me cansa.

weather and seasons.text: On annonce des averses en matinée, puis des éclaircies l'après-midi.
weather and seasons.en: Showers are forecast in the morning, then sunny spells in the afternoon.
weather and seasons.pt: A previsão é de pancadas de chuva pela manhã e depois aberturas de sol à tarde.

weather and seasons.text: Pourvu qu'il fasse beau pour le mariage de Chloé samedi !
weather and seasons.en: Let's hope the weather is nice for Chloé's wedding on Saturday!
weather and seasons.pt: Tomara que faça tempo bom no casamento da Chloé no sábado!

weather and seasons.text: Il a grêlé si fort que plusieurs voitures ont été endommagées.
weather and seasons.en: It hailed so hard that several cars were damaged.
weather and seasons.pt: Caiu tanto granizo que vários carros foram danificados.

weather and seasons.text: Mets de la crème solaire, le soleil tape très fort à cette heure-ci.
weather and seasons.en: Put some sunscreen on; the sun is really beating down at this time of day.
weather and seasons.pt: Passe protetor solar, o sol está muito forte a essa hora.

weather and seasons.text: Les départements de l'Est ont été placés en vigilance orange pour les orages.
weather and seasons.en: The eastern departments have been placed on orange alert for storms.
weather and seasons.pt: Os departamentos do leste foram colocados em alerta laranja para tempestades.

weather and seasons.text: Ce qui me plaît en été, ce sont les longues soirées en terrasse.
weather and seasons.en: What I love about summer is the long evenings sitting outside at cafés.
weather and seasons.pt: O que eu gosto no verão são as longas noites nas mesinhas ao ar livre.

weather and seasons.text: Il se peut qu'il gèle cette nuit, pense à rentrer les plantes.
weather and seasons.en: It might freeze tonight, so remember to bring the plants in.
weather and seasons.pt: Pode ser que gele esta noite, lembre de colocar as plantas para dentro.

weather and seasons.text: Il pleut à verse depuis ce matin et je suis trempé jusqu'aux os.
weather and seasons.en: It's been pouring since this morning and I'm soaked to the skin.
weather and seasons.pt: Está chovendo a cântaros desde de manhã e estou encharcado até os ossos.

weather and seasons.text: L'hiver dernier a été si doux que nous n'avons presque pas allumé le chauffage.
weather and seasons.en: Last winter was so mild that we hardly turned the heating on.
weather and seasons.pt: O inverno passado foi tão ameno que quase não ligamos o aquecimento.

weather and seasons.text: Les jours rallongent enfin, on sent que le printemps arrive.
weather and seasons.en: The days are finally getting longer; you can feel spring coming.
weather and seasons.pt: Os dias finalmente estão ficando mais longos, dá para sentir que a primavera está chegando.

weather and seasons.text: Je n'aurais jamais cru qu'il ferait aussi chaud en plein mois d'octobre.
weather and seasons.en: I'd never have thought it would be so hot in the middle of October.
weather and seasons.pt: Eu nunca imaginaria que fizesse tanto calor em pleno mês de outubro.

weather and seasons.text: La neige tombée hier a fait le bonheur des skieurs dans les Alpes.
weather and seasons.en: Yesterday's snowfall delighted the skiers in the Alps.
weather and seasons.pt: A neve que caiu ontem fez a alegria dos esquiadores nos Alpes.

weather and seasons.text: Quand il fait trop chaud, je ferme les volets pendant la journée.
weather and seasons.en: When it's too hot, I close the shutters during the day.
weather and seasons.pt: Quando faz muito calor, fecho as persianas durante o dia.

weather and seasons.text: Il vaut mieux partir tôt le matin, avant que la chaleur devienne insupportable.
weather and seasons.en: It's better to leave early in the morning, before the heat becomes unbearable.
weather and seasons.pt: É melhor sair cedo de manhã, antes que o calor fique insuportável.

weather and seasons.text: L'air est tellement humide qu'on a du mal à respirer.
weather and seasons.en: The air is so humid that it's hard to breathe.
weather and seasons.pt: O ar está tão úmido que é difícil respirar.

weather and seasons.text: Tu crois que la pluie va s'arrêter avant ce soir ?
weather and seasons.en: Do you think the rain will stop before this evening?
weather and seasons.pt: Você acha que a chuva vai parar antes da noite?

weather and seasons.text: Chaque automne, nous allons ramasser des champignons après les premières pluies.
weather and seasons.en: Every autumn, we go mushroom picking after the first rains.
weather and seasons.pt: Todo outono, vamos colher cogumelos depois das primeiras chuvas.

weather and seasons.text: Avec le réchauffement climatique, les étés deviennent de plus en plus secs.
weather and seasons.en: With global warming, summers are getting drier and drier.
weather and seasons.pt: Com o aquecimento global, os verões estão ficando cada vez mais secos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le week-end, j'aime bien me lever tard et prendre mon temps au petit-déjeuner.
hobbies and weekends.en: At weekends, I like getting up late and taking my time over breakfast.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No fim de semana, gosto de acordar tarde e tomar café da manhã com calma.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je fais de la poterie depuis deux ans et je commence à avoir un bon niveau.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've been doing pottery for two years and I'm starting to get quite good.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Faço cerâmica há dois anos e estou começando a ter um bom nível.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si tu es libre samedi, on pourrait aller voir l'exposition au musée d'Orsay.
hobbies and weekends.en: If you're free on Saturday, we could go and see the exhibition at the Musée d'Orsay.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se você estiver livre no sábado, a gente podia ir ver a exposição no Museu d'Orsay.

hobbies and weekends.text: Bien que je ne sois pas très sportif, je me suis inscrit à un club de randonnée.
hobbies and weekends.en: Although I'm not very sporty, I've joined a hiking club.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Embora eu não seja muito esportista, me inscrevi num clube de caminhada.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon mari passe tous ses dimanches à bricoler dans le garage.
hobbies and weekends.en: My husband spends every Sunday tinkering in the garage.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu marido passa todos os domingos fazendo consertos na garagem.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a passé le week-end à jardiner, et maintenant j'ai mal partout.
hobbies and weekends.en: We spent the weekend gardening, and now I ache all over.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Passamos o fim de semana cuidando do jardim, e agora estou todo dolorido.

hobbies and weekends.text: Elle chante dans une chorale depuis qu'elle est à la retraite.
hobbies and weekends.en: She has been singing in a choir since she retired.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ela canta num coral desde que se aposentou.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'aimerais apprendre à jouer de la guitare, mais je n'ai jamais le temps.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd like to learn to play the guitar, but I never have the time.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu gostaria de aprender a tocar violão, mas nunca tenho tempo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Est-ce que tu as lu le dernier roman de cet auteur dont tout le monde parle ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Have you read the latest novel by that author everyone is talking about?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você leu o último romance daquele autor de quem todo mundo está falando?

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous allons au cinéma presque chaque vendredi soir.
hobbies and weekends.en: We go to the cinema almost every Friday evening.
