hobbies and weekends.pt: Vamos ao cinema quase toda sexta à noite.

hobbies and weekends.text: Il faudrait que je m'y remette, je n'ai pas fait de natation depuis des mois.
hobbies and weekends.en: I should get back into it; I haven't been swimming for months.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu precisava voltar, não faço natação há meses.

hobbies and weekends.text: Thomas collectionne les vieux vinyles qu'il déniche dans les brocantes.
hobbies and weekends.en: Thomas collects old vinyl records that he unearths at flea markets.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Thomas coleciona discos de vinil antigos que ele garimpa em brechós.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ce week-end, on a prévu une sortie à vélo le long du canal.
hobbies and weekends.en: This weekend, we've planned a bike ride along the canal.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste fim de semana, planejamos um passeio de bicicleta ao longo do canal.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je me suis mis à la photographie pendant le confinement et je n'ai jamais arrêté.
hobbies and weekends.en: I took up photography during lockdown and I've never stopped.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Comecei a fotografar durante a quarentena e nunca mais parei.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ça te dirait de venir jouer au tennis avec nous dimanche matin ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you fancy coming to play tennis with us on Sunday morning?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Que tal vir jogar tênis com a gente no domingo de manhã?

hobbies and weekends.text: Je passe mes samedis après-midi à la bibliothèque à lire des bandes dessinées.
hobbies and weekends.en: I spend my Saturday afternoons at the library reading comics.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Passo as tardes de sábado na biblioteca lendo histórias em quadrinhos.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a joué à des jeux de société jusqu'à deux heures du matin.
hobbies and weekends.en: We played board games until two in the morning.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Jogamos jogos de tabuleiro até as duas da manhã.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon fils est passionné d'échecs et participe à des tournois régionaux.
hobbies and weekends.en: My son is passionate about chess and takes part in regional tournaments.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu filho é apaixonado por xadrez e participa de torneios regionais.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je ne crois pas que j'aie la patience nécessaire pour faire des puzzles.
hobbies and weekends.en: I don't think I have the patience needed to do jigsaw puzzles.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Não acho que eu tenha a paciência necessária para montar quebra-cabeças.

hobbies and weekends.text: Depuis qu'elle fait du yoga, Émilie est beaucoup plus sereine.
hobbies and weekends.en: Since she started doing yoga, Émilie has been much calmer.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Desde que começou a fazer ioga, a Émilie está muito mais serena.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a découvert un petit village charmant en nous promenant dimanche dernier.
hobbies and weekends.en: We discovered a charming little village while out for a walk last Sunday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Descobrimos um vilarejo encantador passeando no domingo passado.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche soir, j'essaie de ne rien faire pour être en forme le lundi.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sunday evenings, I try to do nothing so I'm in good shape on Monday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo à noite, tento não fazer nada para estar bem na segunda.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si j'avais plus de temps libre, je prendrais des cours de cuisine.
hobbies and weekends.en: If I had more free time, I'd take cooking classes.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo livre, faria aulas de culinária.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons fait une randonnée de vingt kilomètres dans les Pyrénées.
hobbies and weekends.en: We did a twenty-kilometre hike in the Pyrenees.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fizemos uma trilha de vinte quilômetros nos Pireneus.

hobbies and weekends.text: Il paraît que le nouveau club d'escalade est vraiment bien équipé.
hobbies and weekends.en: Apparently the new climbing club is really well equipped.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Dizem que o novo clube de escalada é muito bem equipado.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'adore flâner dans les marchés le samedi matin.
hobbies and weekends.en: I love wandering around the markets on Saturday mornings.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Adoro passear sem pressa pelas feiras no sábado de manhã.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon copain regarde tous les matchs de foot, ce qui m'agace un peu.
hobbies and weekends.en: My boyfriend watches every football match, which annoys me a bit.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu namorado assiste a todos os jogos de futebol, o que me irrita um pouco.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je me suis inscrite à un atelier d'écriture qui a lieu un jeudi sur deux.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've signed up for a writing workshop that takes place every other Thursday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu me inscrevi numa oficina de escrita que acontece a cada duas quintas-feiras.

hobbies and weekends.text: Pour me détendre, rien ne vaut une longue balade en forêt.
hobbies and weekends.en: To relax, nothing beats a long walk in the woods.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Para relaxar, nada melhor do que um longo passeio na floresta.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons enfin terminé la série que nous regardions depuis des semaines.
hobbies and weekends.en: We've finally finished the series we'd been watching for weeks.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Finalmente terminamos a série que estávamos assistindo havia semanas.

hobbies and weekends.text: Quoi que tu fasses ce week-end, essaie de te reposer un peu.
hobbies and weekends.en: Whatever you do this weekend, try to get some rest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Seja lá o que você fizer neste fim de semana, tente descansar um pouco.

hobbies and weekends.text: Il se peut qu'on aille à la plage samedi, s'il fait assez chaud.
hobbies and weekends.en: We might go to the beach on Saturday, if it's warm enough.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Pode ser que a gente vá à praia no sábado, se estiver quente o bastante.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ma passion, c'est la pêche, même si je reviens souvent bredouille.
hobbies and weekends.en: My passion is fishing, even if I often come back empty-handed.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Minha paixão é a pesca, mesmo que eu volte muitas vezes de mãos vazias.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je cours un semi-marathon en avril, alors je m'entraîne trois fois par semaine.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm running a half marathon in April, so I train three times a week.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vou correr uma meia maratona em abril, então treino três vezes por semana.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le club de théâtre de la ville cherche de nouveaux membres pour son prochain spectacle.
hobbies and weekends.en: The town's theatre club is looking for new members for its next show.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O grupo de teatro da cidade está procurando novos membros para o próximo espetáculo.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a passé un dimanche très tranquille à la maison, ça faisait du bien.
hobbies and weekends.en: We spent a very quiet Sunday at home; it did us good.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Passamos um domingo bem tranquilo em casa, foi ótimo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Avant, je dessinais beaucoup, mais j'ai complètement perdu l'habitude.
hobbies and weekends.en: I used to draw a lot, but I've completely got out of the habit.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Antes eu desenhava muito, mas perdi completamente o hábito.

hobbies and weekends.text: Vous faites quelque chose de spécial pour le week-end de Pâques ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Are you doing anything special for the Easter weekend?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vocês vão fazer alguma coisa especial no feriado de Páscoa?

hobbies and weekends.text: Mes amis m'ont convaincu de les accompagner à un festival de musique en juillet.
hobbies and weekends.en: My friends convinced me to go with them to a music festival in July.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meus amigos me convenceram a ir com eles a um festival de música em julho.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je tricote un pull pour mon petit-fils, j'espère qu'il sera fini avant l'hiver.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'm knitting a jumper for my grandson; I hope it'll be finished before winter.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Estou tricotando um suéter para o meu neto, espero que fique pronto antes do inverno.

home and daily routine.text: Je me lève tous les jours à six heures et demie, même le week-end.
home and daily routine.en: I get up at half past six every day, even at weekends.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu acordo todos os dias às seis e meia, até no fim de semana.

home and daily routine.text: Avant de partir travailler, je prends toujours le temps de boire un café.
home and daily routine.en: Before leaving for work, I always take the time to have a coffee.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de sair para trabalhar, sempre tiro um tempo para tomar um café.

home and daily routine.text: Il faut que quelqu'un sorte les poubelles ce soir, le camion passe demain matin.
home and daily routine.en: Someone needs to take the bins out tonight; the lorry comes tomorrow morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Alguém precisa pôr o lixo para fora hoje à noite, o caminhão passa amanhã de manhã.

home and daily routine.text: Bien que nous partagions les tâches ménagères, c'est souvent moi qui fais la vaisselle.
home and daily routine.en: Although we share the housework, I'm often the one who does the washing-up.
home and daily routine.pt: Embora a gente divida as tarefas domésticas, muitas vezes sou eu que lavo a louça.

home and daily routine.text: Le soir, je prépare les repas pour le lendemain afin de gagner du temps.
home and daily routine.en: In the evening, I prepare meals for the next day to save time.
home and daily routine.pt: À noite, preparo as refeições do dia seguinte para ganhar tempo.

home and daily routine.text: Mon trajet en métro dure quarante minutes, alors j'en profite pour lire.
home and daily routine.en: My metro journey takes forty minutes, so I use the time to read.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu trajeto de metrô leva quarenta minutos, então aproveito para ler.

home and daily routine.text: Est-ce que tu pourrais passer l'aspirateur pendant que je range la cuisine ?
home and daily routine.en: Could you vacuum while I tidy up the kitchen?
home and daily routine.pt: Você poderia passar o aspirador enquanto eu arrumo a cozinha?

home and daily routine.text: On a fait refaire la salle de bains, et maintenant elle est beaucoup plus lumineuse.
home and daily routine.en: We had the bathroom redone, and now it's much brighter.
home and daily routine.pt: Mandamos reformar o banheiro, e agora ele está muito mais iluminado.

home and daily routine.text: Je ne supporte pas que la maison soit en désordre quand on reçoit des invités.
home and daily routine.en: I can't stand the house being messy when we have guests.
home and daily routine.pt: Não suporto que a casa esteja bagunçada quando recebemos visitas.

home and daily routine.text: Le chauffe-eau est tombé en panne, donc on doit prendre des douches froides.
home and daily routine.en: The water heater has broken down, so we have to take cold showers.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecedor de água quebrou, então temos que tomar banho frio.

home and daily routine.text: En rentrant du travail, je vais chercher les enfants à l'école.
home and daily routine.en: On my way home from work, I pick the children up from school.
home and daily routine.pt: Voltando do trabalho, vou buscar as crianças na escola.

home and daily routine.text: Je fais une lessive presque tous les jours avec trois enfants à la maison.
home and daily routine.en: With three kids at home, I do a load of laundry almost every day.
home and daily routine.pt: Com três filhos em casa, lavo roupa quase todos os dias.

home and daily routine.text: Il est temps qu'on change ce vieux canapé, il est complètement usé.
home and daily routine.en: It's time we replaced this old sofa; it's completely worn out.
home and daily routine.pt: Está na hora de trocarmos este sofá velho, ele está completamente gasto.

home and daily routine.text: Le matin, j'écoute la radio en prenant mon petit-déjeuner.
home and daily routine.en: In the morning, I listen to the radio while having breakfast.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã, escuto rádio enquanto tomo café.

home and daily routine.text: Si tu rentres avant moi, pense à arroser les plantes du balcon.
home and daily routine.en: If you get home before me, remember to water the plants on the balcony.
home and daily routine.pt: Se você chegar antes de mim, lembre de regar as plantas da varanda.

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons emménagé dans un appartement de trois pièces près du centre.
home and daily routine.en: We've moved into a three-room flat near the centre.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós nos mudamos para um apartamento de três cômodos perto do centro.

home and daily routine.text: J'essaie de me coucher avant onze heures, mais je n'y arrive pas toujours.
home and daily routine.en: I try to go to bed before eleven, but I don't always manage it.
home and daily routine.pt: Tento me deitar antes das onze, mas nem sempre consigo.

home and daily routine.text: Ma colocataire laisse toujours traîner ses affaires dans le salon.
home and daily routine.en: My flatmate always leaves her stuff lying around in the living room.
home and daily routine.pt: Minha colega de apartamento sempre deixa as coisas dela espalhadas pela sala.

home and daily routine.text: Le dimanche, on fait le grand ménage de la maison.
home and daily routine.en: On Sundays, we give the house a thorough clean.
home and daily routine.pt: No domingo, fazemos a faxina geral da casa.

home and daily routine.text: Il faudrait qu'on appelle un plombier, le robinet de la cuisine fuit encore.
home and daily routine.en: We should call a plumber; the kitchen tap is leaking again.
home and daily routine.pt: A gente precisava chamar um encanador, a torneira da cozinha está vazando de novo.

home and daily routine.text: Je me suis rendu compte que je passais trop de temps sur mon téléphone le soir.
home and daily routine.en: I realised I was spending too much time on my phone in the evenings.
home and daily routine.pt: Percebi que estava passando tempo demais no celular à noite.

home and daily routine.text: Les enfants prennent leur bain à sept heures, puis on dîne tous ensemble.
home and daily routine.en: The children have their bath at seven, then we all have dinner together.
home and daily routine.pt: As crianças tomam banho às sete, e depois jantamos todos juntos.

home and daily routine.text: Où est-ce que tu as rangé les clés de la voiture, je ne les trouve nulle part ?
home and daily routine.en: Where did you put the car keys? I can't find them anywhere.
home and daily routine.pt: Onde você guardou as chaves do carro, não estou achando em lugar nenhum?

home and daily routine.text: Depuis que je travaille de chez moi, j'ai aménagé un petit bureau dans la chambre.
home and daily routine.en: Since I started working from home, I've set up a little office in the bedroom.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que comecei a trabalhar de casa, montei um pequeno escritório no quarto.

home and daily routine.text: Le loyer a encore augmenté, on songe à déménager en banlieue.
home and daily routine.en: The rent has gone up again; we're thinking of moving to the suburbs.
home and daily routine.pt: O aluguel aumentou de novo, estamos pensando em nos mudar para a periferia.

home and daily routine.text: Je fais mes courses en ligne pour éviter de faire la queue au supermarché.
home and daily routine.en: I do my shopping online to avoid queuing at the supermarket.
home and daily routine.pt: Faço minhas compras pela internet para evitar fila no supermercado.

home and daily routine.text: Il est important que chacun mette la main à la pâte à la maison.
home and daily routine.en: It's important that everyone pitches in at home.
home and daily routine.pt: É importante que todo mundo ajude em casa.

home and daily routine.text: Je repasse rarement mes chemises, j'avoue que ça m'ennuie profondément.
home and daily routine.en: I rarely iron my shirts; I admit it bores me to tears.
home and daily routine.pt: Raramente passo minhas camisas, confesso que acho isso extremamente chato.

home and daily routine.text: Notre maison est mal isolée, alors l'hiver la facture de chauffage est énorme.
home and daily routine.en: Our house is poorly insulated, so in winter the heating bill is huge.
home and daily routine.pt: Nossa casa é mal isolada, então no inverno a conta do aquecimento é enorme.

home and daily routine.text: Avant de me coucher, je vérifie toujours que la porte est bien fermée à clé.
home and daily routine.en: Before going to bed, I always check that the door is locked.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de dormir, sempre confiro se a porta está trancada.

home and daily routine.text: Le réveil a sonné mais je me suis rendormi, et j'ai raté mon train.
home and daily routine.en: The alarm went off but I fell back asleep, and I missed my train.
home and daily routine.pt: O despertador tocou, mas voltei a dormir e perdi o trem.

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons installé des panneaux solaires sur le toit l'année dernière.
home and daily routine.en: We installed solar panels on the roof last year.
home and daily routine.pt: Instalamos painéis solares no telhado no ano passado.

home and daily routine.text: Mon mari fait la cuisine en semaine et moi le week-end.
home and daily routine.en: My husband cooks during the week and I cook at weekends.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu marido cozinha durante a semana e eu no fim de semana.

home and daily routine.text: N'oublie pas d'éteindre la lumière en sortant de la pièce.
home and daily routine.en: Don't forget to switch off the light when you leave the room.
home and daily routine.pt: Não esqueça de apagar a luz ao sair do cômodo.

home and daily routine.text: J'ai l'habitude de faire une petite sieste après le déjeuner le samedi.
home and daily routine.en: I usually have a little nap after lunch on Saturdays.
home and daily routine.pt: Costumo tirar um cochilo depois do almoço no sábado.

home and daily routine.text: Le lave-vaisselle fait un bruit bizarre depuis quelques jours.
home and daily routine.en: The dishwasher has been making a strange noise for a few days.
home and daily routine.pt: A lava-louças está fazendo um barulho estranho há alguns dias.

home and daily routine.text: Ce qui me prend le plus de temps le matin, c'est de préparer les enfants.
home and daily routine.en: What takes me the most time in the morning is getting the kids ready.
home and daily routine.pt: O que mais me toma tempo de manhã é arrumar as crianças.

home and daily routine.text: On a enfin fini de déballer tous les cartons, trois mois après le déménagement.
home and daily routine.en: We've finally finished unpacking all the boxes, three months after the move.
home and daily routine.pt: Finalmente terminamos de desempacotar todas as caixas, três meses depois da mudança.

home and daily routine.text: Je voudrais que les enfants rangent leur chambre sans que j'aie besoin de le leur demander.
home and daily routine.en: I'd like the children to tidy their room without my having to ask them.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu queria que as crianças arrumassem o quarto sem que eu precisasse pedir.

home and daily routine.text: Quand je rentre le soir, j'ai juste envie de mettre mes chaussons et de me poser.
home and daily routine.en: When I get home in the evening, I just want to put my slippers on and relax.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando chego em casa à noite, só quero colocar meus chinelos e descansar.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis ravi que vous ayez pu venir malgré la distance.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm delighted you were able to come despite the distance.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico muito feliz que vocês tenham podido vir apesar da distância.

feelings and opinions.text: À mon avis, ce film est un peu surestimé, mais il se laisse regarder.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, this film is a bit overrated, but it's watchable.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, esse filme é um pouco superestimado, mas dá para assistir.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça m'étonnerait qu'il accepte cette proposition sans discuter.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd be surprised if he accepted this offer without arguing.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu ficaria surpreso se ele aceitasse essa proposta sem discutir.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai été profondément touché par les messages de soutien que j'ai reçus.
feelings and opinions.en: I was deeply touched by the messages of support I received.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei profundamente comovido com as mensagens de apoio que recebi.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne suis pas du tout d'accord avec ce que tu viens de dire.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't agree at all with what you've just said.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não concordo nem um pouco com o que você acabou de dizer.

feelings and opinions.text: Il est dommage que si peu de gens s'intéressent à ce sujet.
feelings and opinions.en: It's a shame so few people are interested in this subject.
feelings and opinions.pt: É uma pena que tão poucas pessoas se interessem por esse assunto.

feelings and opinions.text: Franchement, ça m'énerve quand les gens ne disent pas ce qu'ils pensent.
feelings and opinions.en: Frankly, it gets on my nerves when people don't say what they think.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, me irrita quando as pessoas não dizem o que pensam.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve que tu as raison, même si c'est difficile à admettre.
feelings and opinions.en: I think you're right, even if it's hard to admit.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que você tem razão, mesmo que seja difícil admitir.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai peur que mon fils ne se sente seul dans sa nouvelle école.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm afraid my son will feel lonely at his new school.
feelings and opinions.pt: Tenho medo de que meu filho se sinta sozinho na escola nova.

feelings and opinions.text: Bien que je comprenne ton point de vue, je ne le partage pas.
feelings and opinions.en: Although I understand your point of view, I don't share it.
feelings and opinions.pt: Embora eu entenda seu ponto de vista, não compartilho dele.

feelings and opinions.text: J'étais tellement stressé avant l'examen que je n'ai pas dormi de la nuit.
feelings and opinions.en: I was so stressed before the exam that I didn't sleep all night.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu estava tão estressado antes da prova que não dormi a noite toda.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce qui me rend heureux, ce sont les petits moments simples avec mes proches.
feelings and opinions.en: What makes me happy are the simple little moments with my loved ones.
feelings and opinions.pt: O que me faz feliz são os pequenos momentos simples com as pessoas queridas.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis déçu qu'ils n'aient pas tenu leur promesse.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm disappointed they didn't keep their promise.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou decepcionado por eles não terem cumprido a promessa.

feelings and opinions.text: Personnellement, je pense que le télétravail a plus d'avantages que d'inconvénients.
feelings and opinions.en: Personally, I think remote work has more advantages than disadvantages.
feelings and opinions.pt: Pessoalmente, acho que o trabalho remoto tem mais vantagens do que desvantagens.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me fait de la peine de voir mon grand-père si fatigué.
feelings and opinions.en: It makes me sad to see my grandfather so tired.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me dá pena ver meu avô tão cansado.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle a eu un coup de cœur pour cette maison dès qu'elle l'a visitée.
feelings and opinions.en: She fell in love with this house as soon as she visited it.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela se apaixonou por essa casa assim que a visitou.

feelings and opinions.text: Je doute que cette solution soit vraiment efficace sur le long terme.
feelings and opinions.en: I doubt this solution is really effective in the long term.
feelings and opinions.pt: Duvido que essa solução seja realmente eficaz a longo prazo.

feelings and opinions.text: Je me sens beaucoup plus confiant depuis que j'ai changé de travail.
feelings and opinions.en: I feel much more confident since I changed jobs.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu me sinto muito mais confiante desde que mudei de emprego.

feelings and opinions.text: Il est évident que nous devons faire quelque chose pour l'environnement.
feelings and opinions.en: It's obvious that we have to do something for the environment.
feelings and opinions.pt: É evidente que precisamos fazer alguma coisa pelo meio ambiente.

feelings and opinions.text: J'en ai vraiment marre de ces réunions qui ne servent à rien.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really fed up with these pointless meetings.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou realmente cansado dessas reuniões que não servem para nada.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu ne trouves pas que les prix ont beaucoup augmenté ces derniers temps ?
feelings and opinions.en: Don't you think prices have gone up a lot lately?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você não acha que os preços subiram muito ultimamente?

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis fier de toi, tu as travaillé dur pour obtenir ce diplôme.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm proud of you; you worked hard to get this degree.
feelings and opinions.pt: Tenho orgulho de você, você se esforçou muito para conseguir esse diploma.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me gêne un peu qu'on parle de moi derrière mon dos.
feelings and opinions.en: It bothers me a bit that people talk about me behind my back.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me incomoda um pouco que falem de mim pelas costas.

feelings and opinions.text: Je n'arrive pas à croire qu'il soit parti sans dire au revoir.
feelings and opinions.en: I can't believe he left without saying goodbye.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não consigo acreditar que ele tenha ido embora sem se despedir.

feelings and opinions.text: Selon moi, l'éducation est la chose la plus importante pour l'avenir d'un pays.
feelings and opinions.en: In my view, education is the most important thing for a country's future.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, a educação é a coisa mais importante para o futuro de um país.

feelings and opinions.text: J'avoue que j'ai été un peu jaloux quand j'ai appris la nouvelle.
feelings and opinions.en: I admit I was a little jealous when I heard the news.
feelings and opinions.pt: Confesso que fiquei com um pouco de ciúme quando soube da notícia.

feelings and opinions.text: Il me semble que tout le monde mérite une deuxième chance.
feelings and opinions.en: It seems to me that everyone deserves a second chance.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me parece que todo mundo merece uma segunda chance.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis soulagé que l'opération se soit bien passée.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm relieved the operation went well.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou aliviado que a cirurgia tenha corrido bem.

feelings and opinions.text: Qu'est-ce que tu penses vraiment de son nouveau projet ?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you really think of his new project?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você realmente acha do novo projeto dele?

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me surprendrait beaucoup qu'ils se séparent, ils ont l'air si heureux.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd be very surprised if they split up; they seem so happy.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu ficaria muito surpreso se eles se separassem, parecem tão felizes.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai toujours eu du mal à exprimer mes émotions en public.
feelings and opinions.en: I've always found it hard to express my emotions in public.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sempre tive dificuldade de expressar minhas emoções em público.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce n'est pas que je n'aime pas la ville, mais je préfère le calme de la campagne.
feelings and opinions.en: It's not that I don't like the city, but I prefer the peace of the countryside.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não é que eu não goste da cidade, mas prefiro a calma do interior.

feelings and opinions.text: Je regrette de ne pas avoir passé plus de temps avec ma grand-mère.
feelings and opinions.en: I regret not having spent more time with my grandmother.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu me arrependo de não ter passado mais tempo com minha avó.

feelings and opinions.text: Il faut que je t'avoue quelque chose qui me pèse depuis longtemps.
feelings and opinions.en: I have to confess something that has been weighing on me for a long time.
feelings and opinions.pt: Preciso te confessar uma coisa que está me pesando há muito tempo.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis partagé : d'un côté l'offre est intéressante, de l'autre il faudrait déménager.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm torn: on the one hand the offer is interesting, on the other I'd have to move.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou dividido: por um lado a oferta é interessante, por outro eu teria que me mudar.

feelings and opinions.text: Je serais vraiment triste que tu ne puisses pas venir à notre mariage.
feelings and opinions.en: I'd be really sad if you couldn't come to our wedding.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu ficaria muito triste se você não pudesse vir ao nosso casamento.

feelings and opinions.text: On a beau dire, l'argent ne fait pas le bonheur.
feelings and opinions.en: Say what you like, money doesn't buy happiness.
feelings and opinions.pt: Digam o que quiserem, dinheiro não traz felicidade.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve inadmissible qu'on traite les clients de cette façon.
feelings and opinions.en: I find it unacceptable that customers are treated this way.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho inadmissível que tratem os clientes dessa forma.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai été agréablement surpris par l'accueil chaleureux des habitants.
feelings and opinions.en: I was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome from the locals.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei agradavelmente surpreso com a recepção calorosa dos moradores.

feelings and opinions.text: Quoi qu'on en dise, je reste convaincu que c'était la bonne décision.
feelings and opinions.en: Whatever people say, I'm still convinced it was the right decision.
feelings and opinions.pt: Digam o que disserem, continuo convencido de que foi a decisão certa.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonjour, madame Dupont, vous avez passé un bon week-end ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hello, Mrs Dupont, did you have a good weekend?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, dona Dupont, a senhora teve um bom fim de semana?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez vu qu'ils vont enfin refaire la façade de l'immeuble ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you see they're finally going to redo the front of the building?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você viu que finalmente vão reformar a fachada do prédio?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je ne sais pas si vous êtes au courant, mais l'ascenseur est encore en panne.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I don't know if you've heard, but the lift is broken again.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Não sei se você está sabendo, mas o elevador quebrou de novo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait plaisir de vous voir, ça faisait longtemps qu'on ne s'était pas croisés !
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's nice to see you; we haven't bumped into each other for ages!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que bom te ver, fazia tempo que a gente não se cruzava!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre jardin est magnifique, vous devez y passer des heures.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your garden is magnificent; you must spend hours in it.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu jardim está lindo, você deve passar horas nele.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si vous partez en vacances, je peux arroser vos plantes et relever votre courrier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you go on holiday, I can water your plants and collect your post.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se vocês viajarem nas férias, posso regar suas plantas e pegar sua correspondência.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il paraît qu'une nouvelle boulangerie va ouvrir au coin de la rue.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Apparently a new bakery is going to open on the corner.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parece que vai abrir uma padaria nova na esquina.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Excusez-nous pour le bruit hier soir, on fêtait l'anniversaire de notre fils.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry about the noise last night; we were celebrating our son's birthday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe pelo barulho ontem à noite, estávamos comemorando o aniversário do nosso filho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chien a encore aboyé toute la matinée, je me demandais s'il allait bien.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your dog was barking all morning again; I was wondering if he was all right.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu cachorro latiu a manhã toda de novo, fiquei me perguntando se ele estava bem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous habitez dans le quartier depuis longtemps ou vous venez d'arriver ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you lived in the neighbourhood long, or have you just arrived?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você mora no bairro há muito tempo ou acabou de chegar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: J'ai reçu un colis à votre nom, je vous le dépose ce soir ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I received a parcel in your name; shall I drop it off this evening?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Recebi um pacote no seu nome, quer que eu deixe aí hoje à noite?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bien que nous soyons voisins depuis cinq ans, on ne s'était jamais vraiment parlé.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Although we've been neighbours for five years, we'd never really talked.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Embora sejamos vizinhos há cinco anos, nunca tínhamos conversado de verdade.

small talk with a neighbour.text: La réunion des copropriétaires aura lieu jeudi prochain dans le hall.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The residents' association meeting will be held next Thursday in the lobby.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A reunião de condomínio vai ser na próxima quinta, no hall.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vos enfants ont bien grandi, ils sont en quelle classe maintenant ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your children have really grown; what year are they in now?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seus filhos cresceram muito, em que série eles estão agora?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça vous dirait de passer prendre l'apéritif chez nous samedi soir ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Would you like to come over for drinks at our place on Saturday evening?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que tal vocês passarem lá em casa para um aperitivo no sábado à noite?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je crois que quelqu'un s'est garé sur votre place de parking.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I think someone has parked in your parking space.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acho que alguém estacionou na sua vaga.

small talk with a neighbour.text: On a eu un sacré orage cette nuit, vous n'avez pas eu de dégâts ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: We had quite a storm last night; did you get any damage?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que tempestade tivemos esta noite, vocês não tiveram nenhum estrago?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le gardien m'a dit qu'il serait absent toute la semaine prochaine.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The caretaker told me he'll be away all next week.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O zelador me disse que vai estar ausente a semana que vem inteira.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il faudrait qu'on demande à la mairie d'installer un ralentisseur dans la rue.
small talk with a neighbour.en: We should ask the council to put a speed bump in the street.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A gente deveria pedir à prefeitura para instalar um quebra-molas na rua.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous savez si le marché a toujours lieu le mercredi matin ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know if the market is still on Wednesday mornings?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você sabe se a feira ainda acontece na quarta de manhã?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mon mari pourrait vous aider à monter votre armoire, si vous voulez.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My husband could help you assemble your wardrobe, if you like.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu marido poderia te ajudar a montar o seu guarda-roupa, se você quiser.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les nouveaux voisins du troisième ont l'air très sympathiques.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The new neighbours on the third floor seem very nice.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Os vizinhos novos do terceiro andar parecem muito simpáticos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: J'espère que les travaux d'à côté ne vous dérangent pas trop.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I hope the building work next door isn't bothering you too much.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Espero que a obra aqui do lado não esteja incomodando muito.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous n'auriez pas une échelle à me prêter pour une petite heure ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: You wouldn't happen to have a ladder you could lend me for an hour or so?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você não teria uma escada para me emprestar por uma horinha?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait du bien de voir enfin un peu de soleil, n'est-ce pas ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's nice to finally see a bit of sunshine, isn't it?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que bom finalmente ver um pouco de sol, não é?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre fille joue drôlement bien du piano, on l'entend depuis le palier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your daughter plays the piano really well; we can hear her from the landing.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Sua filha toca piano muito bem, dá para ouvir lá do corredor.

small talk with a neighbour.text: On organise une fête des voisins le mois prochain, vous seriez des nôtres ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're organising a street party next month; would you join us?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vamos organizar uma festa dos vizinhos no mês que vem, vocês vêm?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous ai rapporté le plat que vous m'aviez prêté pour la tarte.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've brought back the dish you lent me for the tart.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Trouxe de volta a travessa que você tinha me emprestado para a torta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je trouve que le quartier a beaucoup changé depuis que la gare a été rénovée.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I think the neighbourhood has changed a lot since the station was renovated.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acho que o bairro mudou muito desde que a estação foi reformada.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Faites attention, l'escalier est glissant, la femme de ménage vient de passer.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Be careful, the stairs are slippery; the cleaner has just been.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Cuidado, a escada está escorregadia, a faxineira acabou de passar.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez des nouvelles de monsieur Lambert, celui qui a été hospitalisé ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard anything about Mr Lambert, the one who was taken to hospital?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você tem notícias do seu Lambert, aquele que foi internado?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je me permets de vous demander de baisser un peu la musique après vingt-deux heures.
small talk with a neighbour.en: May I ask you to turn the music down a little after ten p.m.?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tomo a liberdade de pedir que vocês abaixem um pouco a música depois das vinte e duas horas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous partez où cet été, toujours en Normandie ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Where are you going this summer, Normandy again?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Para onde vocês vão neste verão, para a Normandia de novo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il paraît que les loyers vont encore augmenter dans le quartier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Apparently rents are going to rise again in the neighbourhood.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Dizem que os aluguéis vão subir de novo no bairro.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chat s'est encore installé sur notre balcon ce matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your cat made itself at home on our balcony again this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu gato se instalou na nossa varanda de novo hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ce serait bien que l'on se mette d'accord pour tailler la haie ensemble.
small talk with a neighbour.en: It would be good if we agreed to trim the hedge together.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seria bom a gente combinar de podar a cerca viva juntos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ne vous inquiétez pas pour le bruit, on n'a rien entendu.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Don't worry about the noise; we didn't hear a thing.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Não se preocupe com o barulho, não ouvimos nada.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez trouvé un bon médecin depuis que vous êtes arrivés dans la région ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you found a good doctor since you moved to the area?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vocês encontraram um bom médico desde que chegaram à região?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonne soirée, et n'hésitez pas à frapper si vous avez besoin de quoi que ce soit !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a good evening, and don't hesitate to knock if you need anything at all!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Boa noite, e não hesite em bater na porta se precisar de qualquer coisa!

small talk with a neighbour.text: On a de la chance d'avoir un parc aussi agréable juste en bas de chez nous.
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're lucky to have such a nice park right downstairs from us.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Temos sorte de ter um parque tão agradável bem aqui embaixo de casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Bonjour, j'aimerais prendre rendez-vous avec le docteur Moreau, s'il vous plaît.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Moreau, please.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, eu gostaria de marcar uma consulta com o doutor Moreau, por favor.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ne quittez pas, je vous passe tout de suite le service comptabilité.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hold the line, I'll put you through to the accounts department right away.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Aguarde na linha, vou transferir você agora mesmo para o setor de contabilidade.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis en réunion, est-ce que je peux vous rappeler dans une demi-heure ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm in a meeting; can I call you back in half an hour?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou numa reunião, posso te ligar de volta daqui a meia hora?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis désolé, mais je dois annuler mon rendez-vous de jeudi.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm sorry, but I have to cancel my appointment on Thursday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sinto muito, mas preciso cancelar meu horário de quinta-feira.

phone calls and appointments.text: Il faudrait que je déplace notre rendez-vous à une heure plus tardive.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd need to move our appointment to a later time.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu precisaria passar nosso compromisso para um horário mais tarde.

phone calls and appointments.text: La ligne est mauvaise, je vous entends très mal.
phone calls and appointments.en: The line is bad; I can hardly hear you.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A ligação está ruim, estou te ouvindo muito mal.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pourriez-vous épeler votre nom de famille, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you spell your surname, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia soletrar seu sobrenome, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous appelle au sujet de l'annonce que j'ai vue sur votre site.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling about the ad I saw on your website.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando por causa do anúncio que vi no seu site.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le standard est fermé, veuillez rappeler entre neuf heures et dix-sept heures.
phone calls and appointments.en: The switchboard is closed; please call back between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A central está fechada, por favor ligue novamente entre nove e dezessete horas.

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai laissé un message sur son répondeur, mais il ne m'a pas encore rappelé.
phone calls and appointments.en: I left a message on his voicemail, but he hasn't called me back yet.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Deixei um recado na caixa postal dele, mas ele ainda não me ligou de volta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le prochain créneau disponible est mardi à quatorze heures trente, ça vous convient ?
phone calls and appointments.en: The next available slot is Tuesday at 2:30 p.m.; does that suit you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: O próximo horário disponível é terça às quatorze e trinta, está bom para você?

phone calls and appointments.text: Bien que j'aie appelé trois fois, personne n'a répondu.
phone calls and appointments.en: Although I called three times, nobody answered.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Embora eu tenha ligado três vezes, ninguém atendeu.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je voudrais confirmer mon rendez-vous de demain matin chez le coiffeur.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to confirm my hairdresser's appointment tomorrow morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu queria confirmar meu horário no cabeleireiro amanhã de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vais voir s'il est disponible, c'est de la part de qui ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll see if he's available; who's calling, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou ver se ele está disponível, quem gostaria de falar?

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous avez fait un faux numéro, il n'y a pas de Sandrine ici.
phone calls and appointments.en: You've got the wrong number; there's no Sandrine here.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você ligou para o número errado, não tem nenhuma Sandrine aqui.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pouvez-vous me laisser vos coordonnées pour qu'on vous recontacte ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you leave me your contact details so that we can get back to you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode me deixar seus dados de contato para que retornemos?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vais devoir raccrocher, je n'ai presque plus de batterie.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm going to have to hang up; my battery is almost dead.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou ter que desligar, estou quase sem bateria.

phone calls and appointments.text: Il est possible que j'aie un peu de retard, je suis coincé dans les bouchons.
phone calls and appointments.en: I may be a bit late; I'm stuck in traffic.
phone calls and appointments.pt: É possível que eu me atrase um pouco, estou preso no trânsito.

phone calls and appointments.text: Merci de patienter, un conseiller va prendre votre appel.
phone calls and appointments.en: Please hold; an adviser will take your call.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Por favor aguarde, um atendente vai atender sua ligação.

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai essayé de vous joindre toute la matinée, mais ça sonnait occupé.
phone calls and appointments.en: I tried to reach you all morning, but the line was busy.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tentei falar com você a manhã toda, mas só dava ocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pourriez-vous me répéter le numéro plus lentement, s'il vous plaît ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you repeat the number more slowly, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia repetir o número mais devagar, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Si vous ne pouvez pas venir, merci de nous prévenir au moins vingt-quatre heures à l'avance.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you can't come, please let us know at least twenty-four hours in advance.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se não puder vir, por favor nos avise com pelo menos vinte e quatro horas de antecedência.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je n'ai pas reçu le SMS de confirmation, est-ce normal ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I haven't received the confirmation text; is that normal?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não recebi o SMS de confirmação, isso é normal?

phone calls and appointments.text: Madame Petit est en ligne, voulez-vous patienter ou laisser un message ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Mrs Petit is on another call; would you like to hold or leave a message?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A senhora Petit está em outra ligação, quer aguardar ou deixar um recado?

phone calls and appointments.text: On s'appelle ce soir pour fixer l'heure du rendez-vous ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Shall we talk on the phone tonight to set the time for the meeting?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente se fala hoje à noite para marcar o horário do encontro?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je souhaiterais parler à la personne qui s'occupe des réclamations.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to speak to the person who deals with complaints.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu gostaria de falar com a pessoa responsável pelas reclamações.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le garage m'a donné rendez-vous lundi à huit heures pour la révision.
phone calls and appointments.en: The garage has booked me in for a service on Monday at eight.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A oficina marcou a revisão para segunda às oito horas.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je préfère que vous m'envoyiez un e-mail, c'est plus pratique pour moi.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd rather you sent me an email; it's more convenient for me.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Prefiro que você me mande um e-mail, é mais prático para mim.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous pouvez aussi prendre rendez-vous directement en ligne sur notre site.
phone calls and appointments.en: You can also book an appointment directly online on our website.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você também pode marcar horário diretamente pela internet no nosso site.

phone calls and appointments.text: Excusez-moi, la communication a été coupée, je disais donc que je serai là vers midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, we got cut off; as I was saying, I'll be there around noon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, a ligação caiu, eu estava dizendo que vou chegar por volta do meio-dia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ça fait vingt minutes que j'attends avec cette musique d'attente insupportable.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been waiting for twenty minutes with this unbearable hold music.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Faz vinte minutos que estou esperando com essa música de espera insuportável.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je rappellerai demain, à moins que vous ne préfériez que je passe directement.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call back tomorrow, unless you'd rather I came by in person.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ligo de novo amanhã, a menos que você prefira que eu passe aí pessoalmente.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon rendez-vous chez l'ophtalmologiste est seulement dans trois mois.
phone calls and appointments.en: My appointment with the eye specialist isn't for another three months.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha consulta com o oftalmologista é só daqui a três meses.

phone calls and appointments.text: Allô Nicolas, je t'entends à peine, tu es dans le métro ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello Nicolas, I can barely hear you; are you on the metro?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Alô, Nicolas, mal estou te ouvindo, você está no metrô?

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-ce que je pourrais avoir un rendez-vous en urgence, j'ai très mal aux dents ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could I get an emergency appointment? I have a terrible toothache.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu poderia conseguir uma consulta de emergência, estou com muita dor de dente?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous confirme notre entretien vendredi à dix heures dans nos locaux.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm confirming our interview on Friday at ten o'clock at our offices.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Confirmo nossa entrevista na sexta às dez horas no nosso escritório.

phone calls and appointments.text: N'oubliez pas d'apporter votre carte Vitale et votre ordonnance.
phone calls and appointments.en: Don't forget to bring your health insurance card and your prescription.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não esqueça de trazer seu cartão do plano de saúde e sua receita.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je l'ai eu au téléphone hier, il avait l'air en pleine forme.
phone calls and appointments.en: I spoke to him on the phone yesterday; he sounded in great shape.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Falei com ele por telefone ontem, ele parecia estar ótimo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Désolé de vous déranger si tard, mais c'est assez urgent.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry to bother you so late, but it's rather urgent.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe incomodar tão tarde, mas é bastante urgente.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tapez 1 pour le service client ou restez en ligne pour parler à un conseiller.
phone calls and appointments.en: Press 1 for customer service or stay on the line to speak to an adviser.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Digite 1 para o atendimento ao cliente ou permaneça na linha para falar com um atendente.
